sections.title: And the first was the numbering of the people of Israel.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying thus:
"Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of their names, every male by their polls."
"From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel, thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies."
"And with you there shall be a man of every tribe, every one head of the house of his fathers."
"And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben, Elizur the son of Shedeur,"
"Of Simeon, Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai,"
"Of Judah, Nahshon the son of Amminadab,"
"Of Issachar, Nethanel the son of Zuar,"
"Of Zebulun, Eliab the son of Helon,"
"Of the children of Joseph, of Ephraim, Elishama the son of Ammihud; and of Manasseh, Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur."

The number of those counted from the tribe of Reuben was forty-six thousand five hundred.

The sons of Simeon were counted by their generations, by their clans, and by the houses of their fathers; according to the number of their names, from twenty years old and upward, all the men able to go to war.
The number of those counted from the tribe of Simeon was fifty-seven thousand three hundred.

The sons of Judah were counted by their generations, by their clans, and by the houses of their fathers; according to the number of their names, from twenty years old and upward, all the men able to go to war.
The number of those counted from the tribe of Judah was seventy-six thousand six hundred.

The sons of Issachar were counted by their generations, by their clans, and by the houses of their fathers; according to the number of their names, from twenty years old and upward, all the men able to go to war.
The number of those counted from the tribe of Issachar was fifty-four thousand four hundred.

The sons of Zebulun were counted by their generations, by their clans, and by the houses of their fathers; according to the number of their names, from twenty years old and upward, all the men able to go to war.
The number of those counted from the tribe of Zebulun was fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

ከአሴር ነገድ የተቈጠሩት አርባ አንድ ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ።
የንፍታሌም ልጆች በየትውልዳቸው፥ በየወገናቸው፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች፥ እንደ እየስማቸው ቍጥር፥ በየራሳቸው ከሃያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያለው ወንድ ሁሉ፥ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡት ሁሉ፥

ሙሴና አሮን ዐሥራ ሁለቱም የእስራኤል አለቆች እነርሱን የቈጠሩበት ቍጥር ይህ ነው።
ከእያንዳንዱ ነገድ ከየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አንድ አንድ አለቃ ነበረ። ከእስራኤልም ልጆች የተቈጠሩት ሁሉ፥ በየሠራዊታቸው፥ ከሃያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉት፥ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡት ሁሉ፥

ሌዋውያን ግን በየአባቶቻቸው ነገድ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ጋር አልተቈጠሩም።

“የሌዊን ነገድ እንዳትቈጥራቸው፥ ቍጥራቸውንም ከእስራኤል ልጆች ጋር እንዳትቀበል ዕወቅ፤
ነገር ግን በምስክሩ ድንኳንና በዕቃዎችዋ ሁሉ፥ በውስጥዋም ባለው ነገር ሁሉ ላይ ሌዋውያንን አቁማቸው። ድንኳንዋንና ዕቃዎችዋን ሁሉ ይሸከሙ፤ ያገልግሉአትም፤ በድንኳንዋም ዙሪያ ይስፈሩ።

And when thy sanctuary riseth, the Levites shall sound the trumpets; and when thy sanctuary setteth, the Levites shall blow the trumpets; but if another man draw near to minister, he shall be put to death.
And the children of Israel shall pitch, every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts; and every man shall pitch by his own banner, according to the house of their fathers.

Nevertheless, the Levites shall be before the tabernacle of the testimony, that there be no wrath upon the children of Israel; and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of the testimony.
And the children of Israel did all that the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron; so did they.

sections.title: The lineage of Israel shall be recorded in the book of remembrance.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses and Aaron, saying:
"The children of Israel shall each be numbered according to their families, by their fathers' houses, and according to the number of their names, every male by their polls."
In the beginning, on the eastern side, those who shall be numbered with their hosts shall be the people of Judah; and the leader of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
The number of those who were numbered of the host was six hundred and thirty thousand and four hundred.
And beside them shall be the tribe of Issachar; and the leader of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.
The number of those who were numbered of the host was four thousand and fifty.
And beside them shall be the tribe of Zebulun; and the leader of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.
The number of those who were numbered of the host was seven thousand and four hundred.
Of the children of Judah, all who were numbered by their hosts were six thousand and four hundred and eighty. These shall set forth first.
"On the side of the south, according to their hosts, shall be the tribe of Reuben; and the leader of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur."
The numbered army was forty-six thousand five hundred.
And beside them was the tribe of Simeon; and the leader of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
The numbered army was fifty-seven thousand three hundred.
And beside them was the tribe of Gad; and the leader of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
The numbered army was forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
From the camp of Reuben, the numbered were one thousand four hundred fifty-one; they followed in order.
"And afterward the witness shall go forth, among the camps of the Levites; as every man shall go forth in his place, according to his purpose, so shall they go."
"On the side of the sea shall be the camp of Ephraim; and the leader of the children of Ephraim was Elishama the son of Ammihud."
The numbered army was forty-five thousand five hundred.
And beside them shall be the tribe of Manasseh; and the leader of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
The numbered army was thirty-two thousand two hundred.
And beside them shall be the tribe of Benjamin; and the leader of the children of Benjamin was Abidan, the son of Gideon.
The numbered army was thirty-five thousand four hundred.
From the children of Ephraim, all those numbered by their armies were thirty-two thousand one hundred. They were to set out third.
"On the side of the camp of Dan shall be the standard; and the leader of the children of Dan was Ahiezer, the son of Ammishaddai."
The numbered army was sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
And beside them shall be the tribe of Asher; and the leader of the children of Asher was Pagiel, the son of Ocran.
The numbered army was forty-one thousand five hundred.
And beside them shall be the tribe of Naphtali; and the leader of the children of Naphtali was Ahira, the son of Enan.
The numbered army was fifty-three thousand four hundred.

ከእስራኤል ልጆች በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች የተቈጠሩ እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ከየሰፈሩ በየሠራዊቶቻቸው የተቈጠሩ ሁሉ ስድስት መቶ ሦስት ሺህ አምስት መቶ አምሳ ነበሩ።
ሌዋውያን ግን እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ጋር አልተቈጠሩም።
የእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲሁ አደረጉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ሁሉ እንዲሁ በየዓላማዎቻቸው ሰፈሩ፤ እንዲሁም በየወገኖቻቸው፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች ተጓዙ።

sections.title: The four sons of Aaron.

verses.text: And it came to pass on the day when the Lord spoke unto Moses on Mount Sinai, that this was the lineage of Aaron and Moses.
These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
This is the name of the sons of Aaron, who were consecrated to minister in the priesthood, and whose hands were filled with holy anointing.

And Nadab and Abihu offered strange fire before the Lord in the wilderness of Sinai, which He commanded them not; and they died before the Lord, and they had no children. But Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priesthood with their father Aaron.

sections.title: The Work of the Levites

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,
"Thou shalt set apart the Levites from among the children of Israel, and they shall be given to Aaron the priest to minister unto him."
"They shall perform the service of the tabernacle, and they shall keep the charge of the law and the law of the children of Israel before the tabernacle."
"According to all the work of the tabernacle, they shall keep the vessels of the tabernacle and the law of the children of Israel."
"And thou shalt bring the Levites near unto thy brother Aaron and unto his sons, and unto the priests; for they are given unto me from among the children of Israel as a gift."

"Thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons near unto the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall keep their priesthood, and all that is within the sanctuary; if there be any stranger that cometh nigh, he shall be put to death."
And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,
"Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the womb among the children of Israel; therefore the Levites shall be mine."

"For all the firstborn are mine; in the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast; they shall be mine: I am the Lord."

sections.title: The numbering of the Levites

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying:
"The sons of Levi shall be numbered by their families, by the house of their fathers; every male from a month old and upward shall be numbered."
And Moses and Aaron numbered them according to the word of the Lord, as He had commanded them.
These are the names of the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, Merari.
And the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni, Shimei.
And the sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, Uzziel.
And the sons of Merari by their families: Mahali, Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers' houses.
The families of the sons of Gershon were the family of Libni and the family of Shimei; these are the families of the Gershonites.
All the males that were numbered of the Levites from a month old and upward were seven thousand five hundred.
The sons of Gershon shall camp behind the tabernacle toward the west.
The leader of the house of the Gedeonites shall be Elishaph, the son of Lahebel.
The children of Gedeon shall keep the dwelling and the tabernacle of the witness, and the dwelling shall be their abode, and the tabernacle of the witness shall be their refuge.
The dwelling of the entrance, which is at the door of the tabernacle, shall be their abode, and all the work that remains shall be theirs.
And for the family of the Qahatites, the family of the sons of Issachar, the family of the sons of Hebron, and the family of the sons of Uzziel, these were the families of the Qahatites.
And all the men, from one month old and upward, were numbered, and they were eight thousand six hundred; they were to keep the sanctuary.
The families of the children of Qahat shall encamp around the tabernacle on the side of the south.
The leader of the families of the children of Qahat shall be Elishaph, the son of Uzziel.
They shall keep the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, and the service of the sanctuary, and the dwelling, and all the service thereof.
And the leaders of the Levites shall be Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, to oversee the holy things, that they may be kept.
For the family of the Merarites, they were the family of the sons of Mahli and the family of the sons of Mushi; these are the families of the Merarites.
And from among them, all the men, according to their number, from one month old and above, were counted, and they were six hundred and thirty.
The chief of the house of the fathers of the Merarites was Suraihel, the son of Abihiah; they were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.
The sons of Merari were to keep the curtains of the tabernacle, the boards, the bars, the pillars, and the sockets.
All the furnishings, all the service thereof, and all the boards of the tabernacle round about, and the pillars, and their sockets, and the cords, and all the instruments thereof shall be theirs.

On the east side, before the tabernacle of the testimony, shall be Moses and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
By the command of the Lord, Moses and Aaron numbered them; from among all the males of the Levites, from one month old and above, by their families, were counted all the males, twenty-two thousand.

sections.title: The setting apart of the firstborn sons of the Levites in Israel.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying, “Number all the males of the children of Israel from one month old and upward; and take the sum of their names.
“And you shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons; they are wholly given unto him from among the children of Israel.”
And Moses numbered all the males of the children of Israel as the Lord had commanded him.
And the number of the males from among them, from one month old and upward, by their names, was twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.
And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,
“And you shall take the Levites for me from among the children of Israel; and the Levites’ animals you shall take for their animals; and the Levites shall be mine, for I am the Lord.”
Concerning the Levites, because they were not numbered among the children of Israel, there were two hundred seventy-three more than the Levites.
And you shall take five shekels for every one; according to the sanctuary shekel shall you take them; the shekel is twenty gerahs.
And you shall give the money for the redemption of the excess to Aaron and to his sons.”
And Moses took the redemption money from those that were over and above them that were redeemed from the Levites.
And from the children of Israel, the offering was three thousand five hundred shekels, according to the weight of the sanctuary, a weight of the sanctuary was given.
And as the Lord commanded, the Lord spoke unto Moses, and Moses gave the offering of the sanctuary unto Aaron and unto his sons.

sections.title: The deeds of the children of the dawn.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው፦
“ከሌዊ ልጆች መካከል በየወገናቸው፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች የቀዓትን ልጆች ለዩአቸው፤
ከሃያ አምስት ዓመት ጀምሮ እስከ አምሳ ዓመት ድረስ በምስክሩ ድንኳን ይሠሩ ዘንድ ለአገልግሎት የሚገቡበትን ሁሉ ትለያለህ።
በምስክሩ ድንኳን በቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑ ዘንድ የቀዓት ልጆች ሥራ ይህ ነው፤
ሰፈሩ በተነሣ ጊዜ አሮንና ልጆቹ ገብተው የሚሸፍነውን መጋረጃ ያወርዳሉ፤ የምስክሩንም ታቦት ይጠቀልሉበታል፤
በላዩም የአቆስጣውን ቍርበት መሸፈኛ ያድርጉበት፤ ከእርሱም በላይ ሁለንተናው ሰማያዊ የሆነ መጐናጸፊያ ያግቡበት፤ መሎጊያዎቹንም ያግቡበት።
በኅብስተ ገጹ ገበታ ላይም ሰማያዊውን መጐናጸፊያ ይዘርጉበት፤ በእርሱም ላይ ወጭቶቹን፥ ጭልፋዎቹንም፥ ጽዋዎቹንም፥ ለማፍሰስም መቅጃዎቹን ያድርጉበት፤ ሁልጊዜም የሚኖር ኅብስት በእርሱ ላይ ይሁን።
በእነርሱም ላይ ቀይ መጐናጸፊያ ይዘርጉ፤ በአቆስጣውም ቍርበት መሸፈኛ ይሸፍኑት። መሎጊያዎቹንም ያግቡ።
ሰማያዊውንም መጐናጸፊያ ይውሰዱ፤ የሚያበሩባትንም መቅረዝ፥ ቀንዲሎችዋንም፥ መኰስተሪያዎችዋንም፥ የኵስታሪ ማድረጊያዎችዋንም፥ እርስዋንም ለማገልገል የዘይቱን ማሰሮዎች ሁሉ ይሸፍኑ፤
እርስዋንና ዕቃዎችዋን ሁሉ በአቆስጣ ቍርበት መሸፈኛ ውስጥ ያድርጉ፤ በመሸከሚያውም ላይ ያድርጉት።
Upon the golden altar, let the heavenly incense be placed; let the sweet-smelling offering be offered with the fragrant smoke; and let the utensils be gathered.

In the sanctuary, let them bring all the utensils of the service; and let them place them within the heavenly incense; let the sweet-smelling offering be offered with the fragrant smoke; and let them perform upon the altar.
And let them remove the ashes; and let them perform upon the altar; let the red incense be placed upon it;

All the utensils of the service, the basins, the pans, the bowls, the pots, the altar utensils, the incense, all the utensils of the sanctuary, let them be placed; and upon it let the sweet-smelling offering be offered with the fragrant smoke; let the utensils be gathered. And let the red incense be taken, and the purifying agent and the preserving agent be offered with the fragrant smoke; and upon the altar of the sweet-smelling offering, let them perform upon the utensils.

And Aaron and his sons shall carry the sanctuary and all the utensils of the sanctuary; and when the camp is to set out, the sons of Kohath shall bear them. But let them not touch the holy things, lest they die. This is the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting.

And the priest, the son of Aaron, Eleazar, shall be in charge of the oil for the light, and the fragrant incense, and the daily grain offering, and the anointing oil; he shall be in charge of the whole tabernacle, and of all that is in it, of the sanctuary and its utensils he shall keep.
And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
“Do not allow the sons of Kohath to be cut off from among the Levites;
But when they approach the holy things, let them live, lest they die; thus shall Aaron and his sons go in;
Let each man prepare his work and his burden; but let them not approach to see the holy things, lest they die.”

sections.title: The deeds of the sons of Gideon.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
"Count the sons of Gideon from the beginning, by their fathers' houses and by their clans."
"Let them perform the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and all that enter into the service, from twenty-five years old and upward unto fifty years old, shall they number."
"The service of the sons of Gideon is this: to bear and to carry."

"The coverings of the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the congregation, the hanging for the door thereof, and the covering that is above it, the covering of badger skins, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,"
"And the hangings of the court round about, and the hangings for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof."
"All the service of the sons of Gideon, in all their duties, shall be under the command of Aaron and his sons; and ye shall appoint unto them their charge."
"The service of the sons of Gideon in the tabernacle of the congregation is this: they shall be under the hand of the priest, the son of Aaron, Ithamar."

sections.title: The Service of the Sons of Merari

verses.text: "The children of Merari shall number themselves by their families, by the house of their fathers."
"Let them perform the work of the tabernacle of witness, and all that enter into the service, from thirty years old and upward unto fifty years old, shall number themselves."

"In the service of the tabernacle of witness, all their instruments, the boards, the bars, the pillars, and their sockets, and the vessels of the tabernacle, and the covering of the tabernacle, and all the service thereof, shall be accounted."
"And those that encamp round about the tabernacle of witness, their instruments, and their sockets, and the pillars, and their vessels, and all their service, shall be accounted by their names."
"This is the service of the children of Merari, according to all their work in the tabernacle of witness; and they shall be under the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest."

sections.title: The numbering of the Levites

verses.text: And Moses and Aaron, along with the leaders of Israel, counted the sons of the Kohathites by their families, according to their fathers' houses.
They were to serve in the tabernacle of witness from twenty-five years old and upward, even unto fifty years old, all that entered in to perform the service.
According to their families, those counted from among them were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
As the Lord commanded Moses, so did Moses and Aaron count all that were to serve in the tabernacle of witness; this is the number of the sons of Kohath.
And the sons of Gershon were counted by their families, according to their fathers' houses.
They were to serve in the tabernacle of witness from twenty-five years old and upward, even unto fifty years old, all that entered in to perform the service.
Their number, according to their families, was two thousand six hundred and thirty.
As the Lord commanded Moses, so did Moses and Aaron count all that were to serve in the tabernacle of witness; this is the number of the sons of Gershon.
And the sons of Merari were counted by their families, according to their fathers' houses.
They were to serve in the tabernacle of witness from twenty-five years old and upward, even unto fifty years old, all that entered in to perform the service.
Their number was thirty-two thousand two hundred, according to their families, according to the houses of their fathers.
And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, "This is the number of the families of the children of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered."
According to their families and according to the houses of their fathers, all the males from a month old and upward, whom Moses and Aaron numbered, were the leaders of Israel.
All who were to come to do the work of service and to carry the articles in the tabernacle, from thirty years old and upward to fifty years old, were numbered.
From them, the number of those counted was eight thousand five hundred eighty.
As the Lord commanded, each one was numbered according to their service and according to their burden, by the hand of Moses; thus they were numbered as the Lord commanded Moses.

sections.title: For those who are not pure.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,
"The children of Israel shall cast out from among them every leprous thing and every thing that is unclean, and they shall put out all that hath been defiled in their bodies."
"I command them that they shall not defile their camp, from man unto woman, and they shall cast them out from among their dwelling."
Thus did the children of Israel; they cast them out from among their camp; as the Lord had spoken unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.

sections.title: Concerning sin, it is a burden.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,
"Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel: If a man or a woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the Lord, and that person be guilty;
that soul shall be cut off from among their people. And if they confess their sin which they have done, they shall make restitution for their trespass in full, and add one-fifth thereto.
But if the man be poor, and cannot make restitution, then the trespass shall be brought before the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and it shall be added to the altar of the Lord.
And all the holy things which the children of Israel offer unto the Lord shall be the priest's, and the first of all the offerings shall belong to the priest.
And every devoted thing among men shall be the priest's; all that is given to the priest shall be his."

sections.title: Concerning the woman who is called by her husband.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው፦
“ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው፦ የማንኛውም ሰው ሚስት ከእርሱ ፈቀቅ ብትል፥ በእርሱም ላይ ብትበድል፥
ሌላም ሰው ከእርስዋ ጋር ቢተኛ፥ ብታመነዝር፥ ከባልዋም ዐይን ቢሸሸግ፥ እርስዋም ተሰውራ ብትረክስ፥
ምስክርም ባይኖርባት፥ በምንዝርም ባትያዝ፥ በባልዋም ላይ የቅንዐት መንፈስ ቢመጣበት፥ እርስዋም ስትረክስ ስለ ሚስቱ ቢቀና ወይም እርስዋ ሳትረክስ የቅንዐቱ መንፈስ ቢመጣበት፥ ስለ ሚስቱም ቢቀና፥
ያ ሰው ሚስቱን ወደ ካህኑ ያምጣት፤ የኢፍ መስፈሪያም ዐሥረኛ እጅ ገብስ ዱቄት ቍርባን ስለ እርስዋ ያምጣ፤ የቅንዐት ቍርባን ነውና፥ ኀጢአትንም የሚያሳስብ የመታሰቢያ ቍርባን ነውና ዘይት አያፍስስበት፤ ዕጣንም አይጨምርበት።
“ካህኑም ያቀርባታል፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ያቆማታል፤
ካህኑም የተቀደሰ ውኃ በሸክላ ማሰሮ ይወስዳል፤ ካህኑም በምስክሩ ድንኳን ውስጥ ካለው ትቢያ ወስዶ በውኃ ላይ ይረጨዋል፤
ካህኑም ሴቲቱን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቆማታል፤ የሴቲቱንም ራስ ይገልጣል፤ በእጅዋም ለመታሰቢያ የሚሆነውን የእህል ቍርባን፥ የቅንዐት ቍርባን ያኖራል፤ በካህኑም እጅ ርግማንን የሚያመጣው መራራ ውኃ ይሆናል።
ካህኑም ያምላታል፤ ሴቲቱንም እንዲህ ይላታል፦ ሌላ ወንድ አልተኛሽ፥ ባልሽንም አልተውሽ፥ ራስሽንም አላረከስሽ እንደ ሆነ፥ ርግማንን ከሚያመጣ ከዚህ መራራ ውኃ ንጹሕ ሁኚ፤
ነገር ግን ባልሽን ትተሽ ረክሰሽ እንደ ሆነ፥ ከባልሽም ሌላ ወንድ ከአንቺ ጋር ተኝቶ እንደ ሆነ፤
And the priest shall say unto the woman, "If the Lord hath made thee a curse and an oath among thy people, may the Lord cause thy thigh to rot and thy belly to swell;
This water that bringeth the curse shall go into thy belly, and thy womb shall swell; and the woman shall say, "Amen, amen."
"And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water;
The bitter water shall enter into her, and it shall cause her belly to swell.
And the priest shall take the offering of jealousy out of the woman's hand, and shall wave the offering before the Lord, and bring it unto the altar;
And the priest shall take a handful of the offering, even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar; and afterward shall he cause the woman to drink the bitter water.

And when he hath made her to drink the water, it shall come to pass that, if she be defiled and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot; and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
If her belly swells and her thigh rots, she is guilty; and she shall bear her iniquity.
"This is the law of jealousy, when a wife goeth astray and is defiled;
And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, then shall he set the woman before the Lord, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law."
And the priest shall perform all this law. And the man shall be clean from sin; and the woman shall bear her sin.

sections.title: The Law of the Nazarite

verses.text: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው፦
“ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው፤ ወንድ ወይም ሴት ለእግዚአብሔር ራሱን የተለየ ያደርግ ዘንድ ልዩ ስእለት ቢሳል፥
ከወይን ጠጅና ከሚያሰክር መጠጥ ራሱን የተለየ ያድርግ፤ ከወይን ወይም ከሌላ ከሚያሰክር ነገር የሚገኘውን ሆምጣጤ አይጠጣ፤ የወይንም ጭማቂ አይጠጣ፤ የወይንም እሸት ወይም ዘቢብ አይብላ።
ራሱን የተለየ ባደረገበት ወራት ሁሉ ከወይን የሆነውን ነገር ሁሉ ከውስጡ ፍሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ደረቀው ዘቢብ ድረስ አይብላ።
“ራሱን ለመለየት ስእለት ባደረገበት ወራት ሁሉ ራሱን አይላጭ፤ ለእግዚአብሔር የተለየበት ወራት እስኪፈጸም ድረስ ቅዱስ ይሆናል፤ የራሱንም ጠጕር ያሳድጋል።
“ለእግዚአብሔር ራሱን የተለየ ባደረገበት ወራት ሁሉ ወደ ሬሳ አይቅረብ።
ለአምላኩ ያደረገው ብፅዐት በራሱ ላይ ነውና አባቱ፥ ወይም እናቱ፥ ወይም ወንድሙ፥ ወይም እኅቱ ሲሞቱ ሰውነቱን አያርክስባቸው።
በብፅዐቱ ወራት ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ ነውና።
“ሰውም በአጠገቡ ድንገት ቢሞት የራሱ ብፅዐት ይረክሳል፤ እርሱ በሚነጻበት ቀን ራሱን ይላጭ፤ በሰባተኛው ቀን ይላጨው።
በስምንተኛውም ቀን ሁለት ዋኖሶች ወይም ሁለት የርግብ ግልገሎች ወደ ምስክሩ ድንኳን ደጃፍ ወደ ካህኑ ያምጣ፤

And the priest shall offer one for the sin offering and the second for the burnt offering; for the sin that has arisen from the head of the people, it shall be atoned for; and on that day, he shall consecrate himself.

Throughout the months of his vow, he shall be consecrated to the Lord; and at the end of one year, he shall bring a lamb for a burnt offering; but his vow shall not be counted as completed until all the months have passed.
"This is the law for the one who has made a vow; at the end of the months of his vow, he shall bring himself to the door of the tabernacle of meeting and offer his offering to the Lord."
A lamb without blemish for a burnt offering for the one who is to be cleansed from sin, and a female lamb without blemish for the sin offering; and a ram without blemish for the peace offering.
One unleavened cake of fine flour mixed with oil, and one unleavened wafer anointed with oil, and the offering of the grain, and the offering of the drink shall be presented.
And the priest shall present it before the Lord. He shall also offer the sin offering of the one who is to be cleansed.

The ram for the peace offering shall be offered together with the unleavened cake of fine flour; and the priest shall also present the offering of the grain and the offering of the drink before the Lord.
And the one who is to be cleansed shall bring his own head of hair to the door of the tabernacle of meeting; and he shall take the head of hair and place it under the fire of the peace offering.

And the priest shall take the ear of the ram that was offered for the peace offering, and one unleavened cake from the basket, and one unleavened wafer; and the head of hair shall be laid upon the hands of the one who is to be cleansed.

And the priest shall offer all these offerings before the Lord; this is the law of the offerings and the consecrated month for the priest; and thereafter, the one who is to be cleansed shall drink wine.
"The law concerning the offering of the sacrifice of his sin, which he shall bring to the Lord for his sin, is this: as he has sinned, so shall he do according to the law of the sin offering."

sections.title: The Blessing of the Priests

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,
"Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, 'Thus shall ye bless the children of Israel, saying unto them:
"The Lord bless thee, and keep thee;
The Lord make His face to shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee.
"The Lord lift up His countenance upon thee, and give thee peace."
Thus shall they put My name upon the children of Israel, and I will bless them."

sections.title: The leaders of Israel spoke.

verses.text: And it came to pass that Moses completed the tabernacle; he consecrated it and all its furnishings, and the altar and all its vessels, on the day of its consecration.
The twelve leaders of Israel, the leaders of their fathers' houses, presented their offerings; and these were above those who were counted among the leaders of the tribes.
They presented their offerings before the Lord; six covered wagons and twelve oxen, a wagon for every two leaders, and they presented one wagon and one ox before the tabernacle.
And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
"Let there be a service of the tabernacle for the witness, and receive from them for the Levites, according to each one's service, give to them."
And Moses took the wagons and the oxen and gave them to the Levites.
To the sons of Gershon, according to their service, he gave two wagons and four oxen.
From the priests, from the sons of Aaron, from Ithamar's hand, he gave to the Merarite sons, according to their service, four wagons and eight oxen.
But to the sons of Kohath, since their service was the service of the sanctuary, they were not given any; for they were to carry the holy things upon their shoulders.
And the tabernacle was set up on the day it was received; the leaders presented the offerings for the dedication of the tabernacle; and the leaders presented their offerings before the tabernacle.
And the Lord said unto Moses, “Let each ruler bring his offering daily to sanctify the altar; let each ruler bring his offering day by day.”
And on the first day, the ruler who brought his offering was Nahshon, the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah.

And the offering was a fine flour mingled with oil, a good measure filled, the weight thereof being as the weight of the sanctuary, a silver dish of one hundred and thirty shekels, and the weight thereof was a silver bowl of seventy shekels;
And the spoon filled with incense was of gold, weighing ten shekels;
For the peace offerings, one bullock, one ram, and one he-goat of the first year were offered;
And for the sin offering, one young bullock was offered;
And for the burnt offerings, two rams, five male goats, five male kids of the goats, and five one-year-old lambs were offered; this was the offering of Nahshon, the son of Amminadab.
And on the second day, the ruler of the children of Issachar, Nethanel the son of Zuar, brought his offering.

And for the offering, a fine flour mingled with oil, a good measure filled, the weight thereof being as the weight of the sanctuary, a silver dish of one hundred and thirty shekels, and the weight thereof was a silver bowl of seventy shekels;
And the spoon filled with incense was of gold, weighing ten shekels;
For the burnt offering, there shall be one young bull, one ram, and one yearling lamb, a goat for the sin offering;
And for the sin offering, there shall be one young goat;
And for the peace offerings, there shall be two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five yearling lambs of the flock; this was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
On the third day, the leader of the children of Zebulun, Eliab the son of Helon, presented his offering.
His offering was one silver platter weighing one hundred and thirty shekels, filled with fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
And one gold pan weighing ten shekels, full of incense;
For the burnt offering, there shall be one young bull, one ram, and one yearling lamb, a goat for the sin offering;
And for the sin offering, there shall be one young goat;
And for the peace offerings, there shall be two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five yearling lambs of the flock; this was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.
On the fourth day, the leader of the children of Reuben, Elizur the son of Shedeur, presented his offering;

And the offering for the grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with oil, an offering of a pleasing aroma to the Lord; its measure shall be one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour, and its measure shall be one-third of a hin of oil;
And the drink offering shall be of wine, one-fourth of a hin;
For the sin offering, one male goat shall be provided, one unblemished ram, and one year-old lamb for a burnt offering;
For the sin offering, one unblemished female goat shall be provided;
For the peace offering, two oxen, five unblemished rams, five unblemished goats, and five one-year-old lambs shall be provided; this was the offering of Eliashib, the son of Shecaniah.
And on the fifth day, the leader of the children of Simeon, Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, presented his offering;

And the offering for the grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with oil, an offering of a pleasing aroma to the Lord; its measure shall be one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour, and its measure shall be one-third of a hin of oil;
And the drink offering shall be of wine, one-fourth of a hin;
For the sin offering, one male goat shall be provided, one unblemished ram, and one year-old lamb for a burnt offering;
For the sin offering, one unblemished female goat shall be provided;
For the peace offering, there were two goats, five rams, five male lambs, and five one-year-old male kids of the goats; this was the offering of Elishama, the son of Amihud.
And on the sixth day, the leader of the sons of Gad, Elizur the son of Shedeur, presented his offering.

His offering was a fine flour mixed with oil for the grain offering, a weight of thirty shekels, which was like the weight of the sanctuary shekel, one silver plate of one hundred and thirty shekels, and one silver bowl of seventy shekels.
And the weight of the golden spoon was ten shekels, filled with incense.
For the sin offering, there was one goat, one ram, and one one-year-old male kid.
For the sin offering, there was one male goat.
For the peace offering, there were two goats, five rams, five male lambs, and five one-year-old male kids of the goats; this was the offering of Elishama, the son of Amihud.
And on the seventh day, the leader of the sons of Ephraim, Elishama the son of Ammihud, presented his offering.

His offering was a fine flour mixed with oil for the grain offering, a weight of thirty shekels, which was like the weight of the sanctuary shekel, one silver plate of one hundred and thirty shekels, and one silver bowl of seventy shekels.
And the weight of the golden spoon was ten shekels, filled with incense.
For the burnt offering, one male lamb, one year old, without blemish;
And for sin, one male goat;
And for peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five one-year-old lambs; this was the offering of Eliashib, the son of Ahitub.
On the eighth day, the leader of the children of Manasseh, Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur, presented his offering;
His offering was one silver plate filled with fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering, the weight of which was one hundred and thirty shekels, and one silver bowl weighing seventy shekels;
And one gold dish weighing ten shekels, filled with incense;
For the burnt offering, one male lamb, one year old, without blemish;
And for sin, one male goat;
And for peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five one-year-old lambs; this was the offering of Gamaliel, the son of Pedahzur.
On the ninth day, the leader of the children of Benjamin, Abidan the son of Gideoni, presented his offering;

And the offering for the grain shall be fine flour mingled with oil, a good measure, filled; its measure shall be as the measure of the sanctuary, a hundred and thirty shekels shall be one silver shekel, and its measure shall be seven shekels shall be one silver piece;
And the offering of incense shall be a measure of ten shekels of gold;
For the sin offering, there shall be one young bull, one ram, and one goat of the first year as a sin offering for the flock;
For the sin offering, there shall be one young bull;
For the peace offering, there shall be two rams, five young goats, five young rams, and five one-year-old lambs of the flock; this was the offering of Abidan, the son of Gideon.
And on the tenth day, the leader of the children of Dan, Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai, presented the offering;

And the offering for the grain shall be fine flour mingled with oil, a good measure, filled; its measure shall be as the measure of the sanctuary, a hundred and thirty shekels shall be one silver shekel, and its measure shall be seven shekels shall be one silver piece;
And the offering of incense shall be a measure of ten shekels of gold;
For the sin offering, there shall be one young bull, one ram, and one goat of the first year as a sin offering for the flock;
For the sin offering, there shall be one young bull;
For the peace offering, there were two goats, five rams, five male lambs, and five one-year-old male goats; this was the offering of the son of Amisadi, the son of Akiazar.
And on the eleventh day, the leader of the children of Asher, Pagiel the son of Ekron, presented his offering.

And his offering was a fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering, the measure being as the measure of the sanctuary, three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour, and the measure was one silver bowl weighing one hundred and thirty shekels, and the measure was one silver dish weighing seventy shekels;
And the measure filled with incense was one golden ladle weighing ten shekels;
For the sin offering, there was one young bull, one male goat, and one one-year-old male goat.
For the guilt offering, there was one male goat;
For the peace offering, there were two goats, five rams, five male lambs, and five one-year-old male goats; this was the offering of the son of Ekron, the son of Pagiel.
And on the twelfth day, the leader of the children of Naphtali, Ahira the son of Enan, presented his offering.

And his offering was a fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering, the measure being as the measure of the sanctuary, three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour, and the measure was one silver bowl weighing one hundred and thirty shekels, and the measure was one silver dish weighing seventy shekels;
And the measure filled with incense was one golden ladle weighing ten shekels;
ለሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት አንድ ወይፈን፥ አንድ አውራ በግ፥ አንድ የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦት፤
ለኀጢአትም መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ ፍየል፤
ለደኅንነትም መሥዋዕት ሁለት ጊደሮች፥ አምስት አውራ በጎች፥ አምስት አውራ ፍየሎች፥ አምስት የአንድ ዓመት እንስት የበግ ጠቦቶች ነበረ፤ የዔናን ልጅ የአኪሬ መባ ይህ ነበረ።
መሠዊያው በተቀባ ቀን የእስራኤል ልጆች አለቆች ለመሠዊያው መቀደሻ ያቀረቡት መባ ይህ ነበረ፤ ዐሥራ ሁለት የብር ወጭቶች፥ ዐሥራ ሁለት የብር ድስቶች፥ ዐሥራ ሁለት የወርቅ ጭልፋዎች፤
እያንዳንዱም የብር ወጭት መቶ ሠላሳ ሰቅል፥ እያንዳንዱም ድስት ሰባ ሰቅል ነበረ፤ የዚህም ዕቃ ሁሉ ብር በመቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን ሁለት ሺህ አራት መቶ ሰቅል ነበረ።
ዕጣንም የተሞሉ ዐሥራ ሁለት የወርቅ ጭልፋዎች፥ እያንዳንዱ በመቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን ዐሥር ዐሥር ሰቅል ነበረ፤ የጭልፋዎቹ ወርቅ ሁሉ መቶ ሃያ ሰቅል ነበረ።
የሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ከብት ሁሉ ከእህሉ ቍርባን ጋር ዐሥራ ሁለት ወይፈኖች፥ ዐሥራ ሁለትም አውራ በጎች፥ ዐሥራ ሁለትም የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች ነበሩ፤ የኀጢአትም መሥዋዕት አውራ ፍየሎች ዐሥራ ሁለት ነበሩ።
የደኅንነትም መሥዋዕት ከብት ሁሉ፥ ሃያ አራት ጊደሮች፥ ስድሳም አውራ በጎች፥ ስድሳም አውራ ፍየሎች፥ ስድሳም ነውር የሌለባቸው የአንድ ዓመት እንስት የበግ ጠቦቶች ነበሩ። መሠዊያው ከተቀባ በኋላ ለመቀደሻው የቀረበ ቍርባን ይህ ነበረ።
ሙሴም ወደ ምስክሩ ድንኳን እርሱን ለመነጋገር በገባ ጊዜ በቃል ኪዳኑ ታቦት ላይ ካለው ከስርየት መክደኛው በላይ ከኪሩቤልም መካከል የእግዚአብሔርን ድምፅ ይሰማ ነበር፤ ከእርሱም ጋር ይናገር ነበር።

sections.title: The Arrangement of the Seven Lamps

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,
"When thou lightest the lamps, let the seven lamps give light over against the candlestick."
And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the Lord commanded Moses.

And this was the work of the candlestick: it was of beaten gold, of a talent of gold, and the lamps thereof were of two rows; and the bowls thereof were like unto almonds, and the knops and the flowers were of the same. According to the pattern which the Lord showed Moses, so he made the candlestick.

sections.title: The Sanctuary and Service of the Levites

verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
"Bring the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
Thus shall you do to them for their cleansing: Sprinkle water of purification upon them; let them shave their whole bodies, and wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.
And they shall take one young bull and a fine flour mixed with oil for the grain offering, and another young bull for a sin offering.
And you shall bring the Levites before the tabernacle of meeting, and you shall gather together the whole congregation of the children of Israel.
And you shall bring the Levites before the Lord, and the children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites.
And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the Lord as a wave offering from the children of Israel, that they may perform the work of the Lord.
And the Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the young bulls; and you shall offer one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering to the Lord, to make atonement for the Levites.
And you shall stand the Levites before Aaron and his sons, and then offer them as a wave offering to the Lord.
Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be Mine.
"And thereafter, the Levites shall serve in the tabernacle of witness; thou shalt cleanse them, and thou shalt offer a gift before Me on their behalf."
"And they are given entirely to me from among the children of Israel; for among all the children of Israel, I have taken them for myself, even the firstborn of every womb."
"In the land of Egypt, on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast, I sanctified them for myself; they are mine."
"And among the children of Israel, I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn."

"And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of witness, and to make atonement for the children of Israel, that there be no plague among the children of Israel when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary."
"And Moses and Aaron did so unto the children of Israel; and according to all that the Lord commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them."
"And the Levites purified themselves from sin, and washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as a wave offering before the Lord; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them."
"And thereafter, the Levites shall go in to do their service in the tabernacle of witness before Aaron and his sons, as the Lord commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them."
"And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,"

"This is the law of the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward, they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of witness; and from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof, and shall serve no more."
After fifty years, he shall be released from his service. Thereafter, he shall not serve any longer.
And let him serve his brother within the sanctuary; let him keep watch over their weeks. However, let him cease his service. Thus shall you do for each of their weeks for the strangers.

sections.title: Concerning the observance of the Passover feast in Sinai.

verses.text: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel went forth from the land of Egypt, in the second year, in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, that the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
"The children of Israel shall keep the Passover at its appointed time."
"In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, at twilight, ye shall keep it; according to all the ordinances of it, and according to all the rites of it, ye shall keep it."
And Moses spake unto the children of Israel concerning the Passover.
And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, in the wilderness of Sinai, they kept the Passover; as the Lord commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.
And there came men who were unclean by reason of the dead body of a man; and they could not keep the Passover on that day.

And they came near unto Moses and unto Aaron on that day. And those men said, "We are unclean by reason of the dead body of a man; wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the Lord in his appointed season among the children of Israel?"
And Moses said unto them, "Stand still, and I will hear what the Lord will command concerning you."
And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying:

"Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the Passover unto the Lord."
On the fourteenth day of the second month, at evening, you shall observe it; you shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
And let nothing of it remain until morning; nor shall you break any of its bones; according to all the ordinances of the Passover, you shall observe it.

However, if a man is clean and is not on a journey, and does not observe the Passover, that person shall be cut off from his people; because he did not bring the offering of the Lord at its appointed time, that man shall bear his sin.

And if a stranger sojourns among you, and would keep the Passover to the Lord, according to the ordinance of the Passover and according to its statute, so shall he do; you shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger and for him who was born in the land.”

sections.title: And the cloud that was seen as a pillar of fire consumed the dwelling as if it were a flame.

verses.text: On the day when the cloud was taken up, the cloud covered the tabernacle; from evening until morning it was like fire upon the tabernacle.
Thus it was always; by day the cloud, and by night it was like the appearance of fire.
And when the cloud was lifted from the tabernacle, at that time the children of Israel would journey; and when the cloud rested, there the children of Israel would encamp.
At the command of the Lord, the children of Israel would journey; and at the command of the Lord, they would encamp; as long as the cloud rested upon the tabernacle, they remained in their tents.
When the cloud had rested upon the tabernacle for many days, the children of Israel kept the commandment of the Lord and did not journey.
Whenever the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, the children of Israel would journey at the word of the Lord; and at the command of the Lord, they would encamp.

Sometimes the cloud would remain from evening until morning; and when the cloud was lifted in the morning, they would journey. Whether by day or by night, whenever the cloud was lifted, they would journey.
If the cloud remained for many days upon the tabernacle, the children of Israel would remain in their tents and not journey; but when it was lifted, they would journey.
At the command of the Lord, they would encamp; and at the command of the Lord, they would journey; they kept the commandment of the Lord as it was spoken by Moses.

sections.title: The golden cherubim.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
“Make two silver trumpets for yourself; you shall use them for calling the congregation and for directing the movement of the camps.”
When both trumpets are blown, all the congregation shall gather unto you at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
When one trumpet sounds, the leaders of the thousands of Israel shall gather unto you.
And when you blow the trumpet as a signal, the camps that lie toward the east shall set out.

And when you blow the second trumpet as a signal, the camps that lie toward the south shall set out; and when you blow the trumpet for the third time, the camps that lie toward the sea shall set out; and when you blow the trumpet for the fourth time, the camps that lie toward the wilderness shall set out; for to signal the movement, you shall blow the trumpets.
And when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow without sounding an alarm.
And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets; and this shall be a statute forever for your generations.

And when you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets, that you may be remembered before the Lord your God, and you shall be saved from your enemies.

Also in the day of your gladness, and in your appointed feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be a memorial for you before your God: I am the Lord your God.”

sections.title: And Israel arose from Sinai.

verses.text: And it came to pass in the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, that the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the testimony.
And the children of Israel set forward from the wilderness of Sinai, and the cloud abode in the wilderness of Paran.
At the first, the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses, and they set forward.
At the first, the children of Judah set forward according to their armies; and over their army was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
And of the children of Issachar, there was Nethanel the son of Zuar, who was over their army.
And of the children of Zebulun, there was Eliab the son of Helon, who was over their army.
And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.
And the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies; and over their army was Elizur the son of Shedeur.
And of the children of Simeon, there was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, who was over their army.
And of the children of Gad, there was Eliasaph the son of Deuel, who was over their army.
የቀዓትም ልጆች ንዋየ ቅድሳቱን ተሸክመው ተጓዙ፤ እነዚህም እስኪመጡ ድረስ እነዚያ ድንኳኑን ተከሉ።
የኤፍሬምም ልጆች ሰፈር በሥርዐታቸው ከየሠራዊቶቻቸው ጋር ተጓዘ፤ በሠራዊቱም ላይ የኣሚሁድ ልጅ ኤሊሳማ አለቃ ነበረ።
በምናሴም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የፈዳሱር ልጅ ገማልያል አለቃ ነበረ።
በብንያምም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የጋዲዮን ልጅ አቢዳን አለቃ ነበረ።
ከሠራዊቱ ሁሉ በኋላ የዳን ልጆች ሰፈር በሥርዐታቸው ከየሠራዊታቸው ጋር ተጓዘ፤ በሠራዊቱም ላይ የአሚሳዲ ልጅ አኪያዜር አለቃ ነበረ።
በአሴርም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የኤክራን ልጅ ፋግኤል አለቃ ነበረ።
በንፍታሌምም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የዔናን ልጅ አኪሬ አለቃ ነበረ።
የእስራኤል ልጆች ጉዞ እንደዚህ ነበር፤ ከሠራዊታቸው ጋር ተጓዙ።
ሙሴም የሚስቱን አባት የምድያማዊውን የራጉኤልን ልጅ ኦባብን፥ “እግዚአብሔር፦ ለእናንተ እሰጠዋለሁ ወዳለው ስፍራ እንሄዳለን፤ እግዚአብሔር ስለ እስራኤል መልካምን ነገር ተናግሮአልና አንተ ከእኛ ጋር ና፥ መልካምን እናደርግልሃለን” አለው።
እርሱም፥ “አልሄድም፥ ነገር ግን ወደ ሀገሬና ወደ ዘመዶች እመለሳለሁ” አለው።
And He said, "I beseech thee, dwell not with us in the wilderness, and we have also gathered unto thee; do not forsake us;
"If thou goest with us, the Lord shall do for us all the good that we shall do for thee," He said.

sections.title: The people journeyed as they began.

verses.text: ከእግዚአብሔርም ተራራ የሦስት ቀን መንገድ ያህል ተጓዙ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም የኪዳኑ ታቦት የሚያድሩበትን ቦታ ታገኝላቸው ዘንድ የሦስት ቀን መንገድ ትቀድማቸው ነበር።
ሙሴም ታቦቷ በተጓዘች ጊዜ፥ “አቤቱ፥ ተነሣ፤ ጠላቶችህ ይበተኑ፤ የሚጠሉህም ከፊትህ ይሽሹ” ይል ነበር።
ባረፈም ጊዜ፥ “አቤቱ፥ ወደ እስራኤል እልፍ አእላፋት ተመለስ” ይል ነበር።
ከሰፈራቸውም በተጓዙ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር ደመና ቀን ቀን በላያቸው ላይ ነበረ።

sections.title: The place of the tomb.

verses.text: ሕዝቡም በክፋት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አጕረመረሙ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሰምቶ ተቈጣ፤ እሳትም ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ በእነርሱ ላይ ነደደች፤ ከሰፈሩም አንዱን ወገን በላች።
ሕዝቡም ወደ ሙሴ ጮኹ፤ ሙሴም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸለየ፤ እሳቲቱም ጠፋች።
ከእግዚአብሔርም ዘንድ በእነርሱ ላይ እሳት ስለ ነደደች የዚያ ስፍራ ስም “መካነ ውዕየት” ተብሎ ተጠራ።

sections.title: And the manna descended from heaven for Israel.

verses.text: And the people who were mixed among them greatly desired; and the children of Israel sat down and said, "Who will give us meat to eat?
We remember the fish which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic.
But now our soul is dried away; there is nothing at all, besides this manna, before our eyes."
And the manna was as coriander seed, and the color thereof as the color of bdellium.
And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it; and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.
And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.
And Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent; and the anger of the Lord was kindled greatly; and Moses also was displeased.
And Moses said unto the Lord, "Wherefore hast Thou afflicted Thy servant? And wherefore have I not found favor in Thy sight, that Thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?

Have I conceived all this people? Have I begotten them, that Thou shouldest say unto me, 'Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child,' unto the land which Thou swarest unto their fathers?
Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? For they weep unto me, saying, 'Give us flesh, that we may eat.'"
Truly, I am exceedingly burdened, and I am unable to bear all this people alone.

If thus you will deal with me, I pray you, let me find grace in your sight; for if I have found favor in your sight, let not the burden of this people be upon me; I beseech you, do not kill me outright.

sections.title: The selection of the shepherd of men.

verses.text: And the Lord said unto Moses, “Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.”

And I will come down and talk with thee there; and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.

And the people spake unto them, saying, “Who shall give us flesh to eat? We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic: but now our soul is dried away; there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.”
Ye shall not eat it one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days.

But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you; because that ye have despised the Lord which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, “Why came we forth out of Egypt?”
And Moses said, “The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, ‘I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.’”
Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? Or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?”
And the Lord said unto Moses, “Is the Lord's hand waxed short? Thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.”
And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the Lord, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.

And the Lord came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.

And there were two men in the camp; the name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other was Medad; and the Spirit rested upon them, and they were of those who were written, but they did not go out to the tabernacle; and they prophesied in the camp.
And there ran a young man, and told Moses, saying, "Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp."
And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, said, "My lord Moses, forbid them."
And Moses said unto him, "Enviest thou for my sake? Would God that all the Lord's people were prophets, and that the Lord would put his Spirit upon them!"
And Moses returned unto the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

sections.title: As the dew descends upon them.

verses.text: And the spirit went forth from the Lord; and it brought forth the creatures of the sea; and for one day, as it were, in this, for one day, as it were, in that, they spoke concerning the dwelling; and there, around the dwelling, there was a height from the earth to above, of two cubits.

And on that day, all the people, by night and by day, arose and gathered the creatures; and they gathered together a little, as it were, ten measures of the harvest of the corn; and all around the dwelling, they set them and they rested.
And the flesh was still among their bones without their seeing it, yet the Lord utterly destroyed His people with a great destruction.
The people of the slain were gathered there, and that place was called "the grave of the slain."
And the people journeyed from the grave of the slain to Assyroth; and they dwelt in Assyroth.

sections.title: And Aaron and Miriam spoke against Moses, as they had been opposed to him.

verses.text: And Moses had taken a wife from Ethiopia, and because of the Ethiopian woman, Miriam and Aaron spoke against him.
And they said, "Has the Lord indeed spoken only through Moses? Has He not spoken through us also?" And the Lord heard it.
Now Moses was very humble, more than all men who were on the face of the earth.
And the Lord spoke suddenly to Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, saying, "Come out, you three, to the tabernacle of meeting." So the three came out.
Then the Lord came down in the pillar of cloud and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam. And they both went forward.
He said, "Hear now My words: If there is a prophet among you, I, the Lord, make Myself known to him in a vision; I speak to him in a dream.
Not so with My servant Moses; he is faithful in all My house.
I speak with him face to face, even plainly, and not in dark sayings; and he sees the form of the Lord. Why then were you not afraid to speak against My servant Moses?"
And the anger of the Lord was aroused against them, and He departed.
And when the cloud departed from above the tabernacle, suddenly Miriam became leprous, as white as snow; then Aaron turned toward Miriam, and there she was, a leper.
And Aaron said unto Moses, “O my lord, we have sinned; we have transgressed, I beseech thee, do not lay this sin upon us.”
As she was in the pangs of childbirth, she did not exchange her flesh for death.
And Moses cried unto the Lord, saying, “O my Lord, I beseech thee, have mercy.”
And the Lord said unto Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received again.”
And Miriam was shut out from the camp for seven days; and the people did not journey until Miriam was brought in again.
And afterward the people journeyed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.

sections.title: And the spies sent unto Canaan.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,
"Send men that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel; of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them."
And Moses, by the command of the Lord, sent them from the wilderness of Paran; and they were all men which were heads of the children of Israel.
And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur;
Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori;
Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh;
Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph;
Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun;
Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu;
Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi;
From the tribe of Joseph, from the descendants of Manasseh, the son of Susi, is Gad;
From the tribe of Dan, the son of Gemali, is Ahiezer;
From the tribe of Asher, the son of Michael, is Sathur;
From the tribe of Naphtali, the son of Abiezer, is Nahbi;
From the tribe of Gad, the son of Makir, is Guni;
These are the names of the men whom Moses sent to explore the land. And Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun, Joshua.
Moses sent them to explore the land of Canaan, and he said to them, “Go up this way into the Negev, and go up into the hill country.”
And how is the land? Is it good or bad? Are the people who dwell there strong or weak, few or many?
Is the land in which they dwell good or bad? Are the cities in which they dwell camps or strongholds?
Is the land rich or poor? Is there wood in it or not? Be of good courage, and bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the season of the first ripe grapes.
And they went forth; and the wilderness was from Zin unto the border of Edom, even unto the wilderness of Paran, according to their journeys.
And they went into the wilderness, and they came unto Kebrón; and there were the sons of Enoch, Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai. And Kebrón was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.

And they came unto the valley which is called the valley of the grapes; and they cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates and of the figs.
And the children of Israel called the name of that place the valley of the grapes, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from thence.

sections.title: The Book of the Chronicles of the Gibeonites

verses.text: And they returned after forty days, having spied out the land.

And they came to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel in the wilderness of Paran at Kadesh; and they brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.
And they told him, saying, “We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.”
Nevertheless, the people that dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are walled, and very great; and moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.
Moreover, we saw the giants there, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants; and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”
And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.”
But the men that went up with him said, “We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”

And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of great stature.”
And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants; and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”

sections.title: The people’s lament.

verses.text: And the congregation lifted up their voice and cried out; and the people murmured all night long.
And all the children of Israel gathered together against Moses and Aaron; and the congregation said, “Would that we had died in this wilderness, or that we had died in the land of Egypt!”
“Why has the Lord brought us to this land to fall by the sword? Our wives and our children will become prey; would it not be better for us to return to Egypt?” they said.
And they said to one another, “Let us choose a leader and go back to Egypt.”
And Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
And those who had been with them, the son of Nun, Joshua, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, tore their clothes.
And they spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land which we passed through to explore is an exceedingly good land.”
“If the Lord delights in us, He will bring us into this land and give it to us; a land which flows with milk and honey.”
“Nevertheless, do not rebel against the Lord, nor fear the people of the land, for they are our bread; their protection has departed from them, and the Lord is with us; do not fear them,” they said.
But the whole congregation said, “Let us stone them with stones.” And the glory of the Lord appeared to all the children of Israel at the tent of meeting.

sections.title: And Moses prayed for the people.

verses.text: And the Lord said unto Moses, “How long will this people provoke me? And how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shown among them?
“I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them; and I will make of thee a nation greater and mightier than they.”
And Moses said unto the Lord, “The Egyptians will hear it; for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;

The people of this land have heard that thou, Lord, art among this people, that thou, Lord, art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that in the daytime thou goest before them in a pillar of a cloud, and in the night in a pillar of fire.
If thou shalt kill this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,
“Because the Lord was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.”
Now, I beseech thee, let the power of my Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,

“The Lord is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.”
“Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people from Egypt even until now.”
And the Lord said unto Moses, “I have pardoned according to thy word;”
ነገር ግን እኔ ሕያው ነኝ፤ ስሜም ሕያው ነው፤ በእውነት የእግዚአብሔር ክብር ምድርን ሁሉ ይሞላል።
በግብፅ ምድርና በምድረ በዳ ያደረግሁትን ተአምራቴንና ክብሬን ያዩ እነዚህ ሰዎች ሁሉ ዐሥር ጊዜ ስለ ተፈታተኑኝ፥ ቃሌንም ስላልሰሙ፥
በእውነት ለአባቶቻቸው የማልሁላቸውን ምድር አያዩም፤ ከእኔ ጋር በዚህ ላሉ መልካምንና ክፉን ለይተው ለማያውቁ ልጆቻቸው፥ የሚያውቀው ለሌለ ለታናሹ ሁሉ ያችን ሀገር እሰጣታለሁ፤ ለጥፋት ያነሳሱኝ ሁሉ አያዩአትም።
ወዳጄ ካሌብ ግን ሌላ መንፈስ በእርሱ ላይ ስለ ሆነና ስለ ተከተለኝ እርሱ ወደ ገባባት ምድር አገባዋለሁ፤ ዘሩም ይወርሳታል።
ዐማሌቅና ከነዓናዊውም በሸለቆ ውስጥ ተቀምጠዋል፤ እናንተ ግን ነገ ተመልሳችሁ በኤርትራ ባሕር መንገድ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ሂዱ።”

sections.title: The people who have perished are as those who have been cut off.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses and Aaron, saying:
"How long shall I bear with this evil congregation that murmurs against Me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against Me."
Thus saith the Lord: "As I live, I will surely do unto you as I have heard you speak in Mine ears."
"In this wilderness shall your bodies fall; all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against Me."
"But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, shall remain alive; they alone shall enter the land which I swore to give unto them."
"Your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised."
"But as for you, your bodies shall fall in this wilderness."
"And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcasses be wasted in the wilderness."
"After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know My breach of promise."
"I am the Lord: I have spoken it; I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation that are gathered together against Me; in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die."
And Moses sent to spy out the land, and those who returned spoke of it before all the congregation, and they brought forth an evil report concerning it.
Therefore, they spoke of that land as being evil; and those men who spoke of that land as evil perished before the Lord in the plague; but the land was indeed good.
Yet, of those who went to spy out the land, only Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive.

sections.title: The first attempt to seize the land.

verses.text: And Moses spoke these words to all the children of Israel. And the people were greatly distressed;
And at evening they rose up and went up to the top of the mountain, and said, “Behold, we are here; we will go up to the place where the Lord has spoken to us.”
And Moses said, “Why do you transgress the command of the Lord? This shall not be good for you.”
For the Lord is not with you, lest you be defeated before your enemies; do not go up.
For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are before you, and you shall fall by the sword; for you have turned back from following the Lord, and therefore the Lord will not be with you.”
But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain; nevertheless, the covenant word of the Lord and Moses did not depart from the camp.
And there on the mountain, the Amalekites and the Canaanites came down and struck them, and they chased them as far as Hormah. And they returned to the city.

sections.title: The Law of Sacrifice

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
"Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel: When ye come into the land which I give unto you,

whether it be for your freewill offerings or for your solemn feasts, ye shall offer unto the Lord a good sacrifice, that is, a bullock or a goat, or a burnt offering, or a sacrifice of fire unto the Lord, as ye bring them in."
"The sacrifice which is offered unto the Lord shall be of the first quality, a fine flour mingled with oil, and of the second quality, a good flour for the sacrifice."

"For the drink offering, it shall be of the first quality, a fine flour mingled with oil, or it shall be done upon the flour offering; for each and every lamb, let there be a good sacrifice unto the Lord, and let it be done accordingly."

"For one young bullock that is offered, or for a sacrifice that ye make, if it be of the first quality, it shall be mingled with oil, and from the sacrifice of the tenth part, let there be two tenths of fine flour for the flour offering."
"For the drink offering, it shall be a good sacrifice unto the Lord, and it shall be of the third quality, and wine shall be offered."
"For the sacrifice that is offered, or for another sacrifice, or for the fulfillment of a vow, or for a peace offering, if ye prepare it for the Lord,
upon the lamb, it shall be of the first quality, a fine flour mingled with oil, and from the sacrifice of the tenth part, let there be three tenths of fine flour for the flour offering."
"For the Lord to be a good sacrifice, for the burnt offering that is made by fire, it shall be of the first quality, and for the drink offering, let there be a good sacrifice."
"Thus shall it be done for each one of you, whether for each male goat, or for each ram, or for each lamb, or for each kid of the goats."
"As you have prepared your number, so shall you do for each one of them according to their number."
"Every son of the land shall present an offering to the Lord, that it may be a good sacrifice when it is offered."
"Even if a scribe were to dwell among you, or if any man were to be found among your generations, when you present a good sacrifice to the Lord by fire, he shall do likewise as you do."

"For you, and for the scribes who dwell among you, there shall be one statute; and for your children, it shall be a perpetual statute; you shall be as you are, and thus shall a scribe be before the Lord."
"For you and for the scribe who dwells among you, there shall be one law and one judgment."
"And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:"
"Speak to the children of Israel, saying:"
"When you come into the land of your possession, and you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer a separate sacrifice to the Lord."
"The first of your dough you shall set apart as a heave offering; as you do with the heave offering of the threshing floor, so shall you set it apart."
And in the beginning, as you shall do, a special offering shall be given to the Lord your God, even unto your children’s children.

sections.title: For the sin that is not known, a sacrifice shall be offered.

verses.text: "If you act stubbornly, the Lord commanded Moses concerning all these commandments, that you should not do them,
From the day that the Lord commanded it, from the first day until your children, the Lord will not act according to your commandments as you have commanded through the hand of Moses,

If there be an unrecognized sin among the congregation, the whole congregation shall bring a pure offering from the flocks, and it shall be for the Lord a good sacrifice, that it may be accepted. The offering of flour and the offering of drink shall be according to the law; and for sin, they shall offer a young bull as a sin offering.

The priest shall make atonement for the children of Israel, for the whole congregation; for they were ignorant, and he shall make atonement for them; and they shall offer their sacrifices and their offerings to the Lord for their sins and for their ignorance.
For the whole people have acted without knowledge, and for the children of Israel, the whole congregation shall make atonement for you when a scribe comes among you.
"If a man sins unintentionally, he shall bring for his sin an offering of a yearling female goat.
The priest shall make atonement for the one who has sinned, for he acted without knowledge; and for the sin that he committed, he shall make atonement before the Lord.
If he be among the children of Israel, or if he be a scribe among them, the law shall be the same for all who sin unintentionally.
Whether he be a native of the land or a scribe, if a man acts with pride, he has despised the Lord; and that man shall be cut off from among his people.
Because he has despised the word of the Lord, and has broken His commandment, that man shall surely be cut off; his sin is upon himself."

sections.title: The man who is angry concerning the Sabbath.

verses.text: And the children of Israel were in the wilderness; and a man was found gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.
And those who found him gathering sticks on the Sabbath day brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation of the children of Israel.
And they said unto him, “What shall be done to him? For he was not put to death.”
And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying, “The man shall be surely put to death; all the congregation shall stone him with stones outside the camp.”
And all the congregation brought him without the camp and stoned him with stones, as the Lord commanded Moses.

sections.title: Concerning the garment upon which the dye is applied.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,

"Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel: They shall make fringes on the corners of their garments throughout their generations, and they shall put upon the fringe of the borders a ribbon of blue.

And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the Lord, and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring.
That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.
I am the Lord your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the Lord your God."

sections.title: Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, as they perished.

verses.text: The son of Levi, the son of Kohath, the son of Izhar, Korah, spoke with the sons of Eliab, the sons of Dathan and Abiram, and with the sons of Reuben, with the son of Pallu, the son of Alian.
And they rose up against Moses; and with them were two hundred and fifty leaders of the congregation, chosen from among the children of Israel, men of renown.

And they gathered together against Moses and Aaron, and said to them, "You take too much upon yourselves, for all the congregation is holy, every one of them, and the Lord is among them. Why then do you exalt yourselves above the assembly of the Lord?"
And when Moses heard it, he fell on his face.

And he spoke to Korah and all his company, saying, "Tomorrow the Lord will show who are His and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to Him; that one whom He chooses He will cause to come near to Him."
Thus do this: Take censers, Korah and all your company,
and put fire in them and put incense in them before the Lord tomorrow; and it shall be that the man whom the Lord chooses is the holy one. You take too much upon yourselves, you sons of Levi!"
And Moses said to Korah, "Hear now, you sons of Levi:

Is it a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to Himself, to do the work of the tabernacle of the Lord, and to stand before the congregation to serve them?
And that He has brought you near to Himself, you and all your brethren, the sons of Levi, with you? And are you seeking the priesthood also?"
Therefore, you and all your congregation have been gathered before the Lord; and who is Aaron that you should grumble against him?
And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, "We will not come up."
Will you make us die in the wilderness, that you may be our leader? And will you bring us up from a land flowing with milk and honey to kill us in the wilderness?
Are you a leader? Or will you bring us to a land flowing with milk and honey? Have you taken away our fields and vineyards? Will you put out the eyes of these men? We will not come up," they said.
And Moses was greatly displeased; and he said to the Lord, "Do not regard their offering; I have not taken one donkey from them, nor have I harmed any of them."
And Moses said to Korah, "You and all your congregation stand before the Lord; you, and your congregation, and Aaron, be ready."

And all of you take your censers; and put fire in them, and put incense in them before the Lord; and each one of you bring his censer before the Lord, two hundred and fifty censers; you and Aaron also bring your censers," he said.
And each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it; and Moses and Aaron stood at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
And Korah gathered all the congregation against them at the entrance of the tent of meeting; and the glory of the Lord appeared to all the congregation.
And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying, "Thus shall you say to them:"
“ሁሉን በቅጽበት አጠፋቸው ዘንድ ከዚህ ማኅበር መካከል ፈቀቅ በሉ።”
እነርሱም በግንባራቸው ወድቀው፥ “የነፍስና የሥጋ ሁሉ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ አንድ ሰው ኀጢአት ቢሠራ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በማኅበሩ ላይ ይሆናልን?” አሉ።
እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው፦
“ለማኅበሩ፦ ከቆሬ ማኅበር ዙሪያ ፈቀቅ በሉ ብለህ ንገራቸው።”
ሙሴም ተነሥቶ ወደ ዳታንና ወደ አቤሮን ሄደ፤ የእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ሄዱ።
ማኅበሩንም፥ “ከእነዚህ ክፉዎች ሰዎች ድንኳን ፈቀቅ በሉ፤ በኀጢአታቸውም ሁሉ እንዳትጠፉ ለእነርሱ የሆነውን ሁሉ አትንኩ” ብሎ ተናገራቸው።
ከቆሬ ድንኳን ዙሪያም ሁሉ ፈቀቅ አሉ፤ ዳታንና አቤሮንም ከሴቶቻቸው፥ ከልጆቻቸውና ከጓዛቸው ጋር ወጥተው በድንኳኖቻቸው ደጃፍ ቆሙ።
ሙሴም አለ፥ “ይህን ሥራ ሁሉ አደርግ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ላከኝ እንጂ ከልቤ እንዳይደለ በዚህ ታውቃላቸሁ።
እነዚህ ሰዎች ሰው እንደሚሞት ቢሞቱ፥ ወይም መቅሠፍታቸው እንደ ሰው ሁሉ መቅሠፍት ቢሆን እግዚአብሔር አልላከኝም።
እግዚአብሔር ግን አዲስ ነገር ቢፈጥር፥ ምድርም አፍዋን ከፍታ እነርሱን፥ ቤታቸውን፥ ድንኳናቸውን፥ ለእነርሱም ያለውን ሁሉ ብትውጣቸው፥ በሕይወታቸውም ወደ ሲኦል ቢወርዱ፥ ያንጊዜ እነዚህ ሰዎች እግዚአብሔርን እንደ አስቈጡ ታውቃላቸሁ።”
And it came to pass; when this word was spoken, the land which was beneath them was shaken.
The earth opened her mouth and swallowed them, and their households, and all the men that were with Korah, and all their goods.
And they and all that belonged to them went down alive into the pit; and the earth closed upon them, and they perished from among the congregation.
And all the congregation of the children of Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up also.”
And there came out a fire from the Lord, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.
And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
