“Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed,

The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar; for they offered them before the Lord, therefore they are hallowed, and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.”
And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest took the brasen censers, which they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar,

To be a memorial unto the children of Israel, that no stranger, which is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the Lord; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as the Lord said to him by the hand of Moses.

sections.title: Aaron led the people as a shepherd.

verses.text: And in the evening, all the children of Israel said, "You have made us the people of the Lord," and they gathered against Moses and Aaron.
And it came to pass that when the congregation was gathered against Moses and Aaron, the cloud covered the tabernacle, and behold, the glory of the Lord appeared.
And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation.
And the Lord spoke unto Moses and Aaron, saying:
"Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment." And they fell upon their faces.

And Moses said unto Aaron, "Take your censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them; for there is wrath gone out from the Lord; the plague is begun."
And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and behold, the plague was begun among the people; and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.
And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
And those that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.
And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation; and the plague was stayed.

sections.title: As Aaron's rod blossomed.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,

“Speak unto the children of Israel; from among them, from each of their fathers' houses, shall you take one by one, and from their leaders, from each of their fathers' houses, shall you take twelve by their tribes; and you shall write the name of each man upon his rod.
For each of their fathers' houses, a rod shall be given, and upon the rod of Levi, you shall write the name of Aaron.
And you shall bring them before me in the tabernacle of the congregation, and I will cause them to be known before the witness.
Thus it shall be; the man whom I choose shall be the rod that blossoms; and I will cause to cease from among you the murmurings of the children of Israel, whereby they murmur against me.”

And Moses spoke unto the children of Israel; and their leaders gave unto each one a rod; for one leader, one rod, according to the houses of their fathers, twelve rods; and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.
And Moses placed the rods before the Lord in the tabernacle of witness.

And it came to pass, that on the morrow, Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of witness; and behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi had budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.
And Moses brought out all the rods from before the Lord unto all the children of Israel; and they looked, and took every man his rod.
And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying, “To cause the murmurings of them to cease from before me, that they die not, you shall keep the rod of Aaron before the witness.”
ሙሴና አሮንም፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው አደረጉ፤ እንዲሁ አደረጉ።
የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሙሴን አሉት፥ “እነሆ፥ እንሞታለን፤ እንጠፋለን፤ ሁላችንም እናልቃለን።
የእግዚአብሔርን ድንኳን የሚነካ ሁሉ ይሞታል። በውኑ ሁላችን ፈጽመን እንሞታለን?”

sections.title: The Service of the Priests and the Levites

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Aaron, saying, “Thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood, and the iniquity of your father's house shall ye bear with you.”
Moreover, gather thy brethren, the tribe of Levi, unto thee, that they may be joined unto thee in unity; let them serve thee, and thou and thy sons shall be before the testimony in the tabernacle.
And they shall keep thy charge and the charge of the tabernacle; but let them not die, and ye also shall not die with them; they shall not come near the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar.
But let them be joined unto you in unity; and for all the service of the tabernacle, let them keep the charge of the testimony; and let no stranger draw nigh unto you.
Take heed, therefore, that ye keep the law of the sanctuary and the law of the altar, lest there be wrath upon the children of Israel.
And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel; they are given unto the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, as a gift unto the Lord.
Thou and thy sons with thee shall keep the charge of your priesthood, and all the service of the tabernacle; and let no stranger approach unto you, lest he be put to death.”

sections.title: The portion of the priests from the sacrifice.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔርም አሮንን ተናገረው፤ እንዲህም አለው፥ “እነሆ፥ የእስራኤል ልጆች ለእኔ የለዩትን የመጀመሪያውን ቍርባኔን ሁሉ ትጠብቁ ዘንድ ለአንተ ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤ ለአንተ እስክታረጅ፥ ከአንተም በኋላ ለልጆችህ የዘለዓለም ሕግ እንዲሆን ሰጥቼሃለሁ።
በእሳት ከሚቀርበው ከተቀደሰው ይህ ለአንተ ይሆናል፤ ለእኔ የሚያመጡት መባቸው ሁሉ፥ ቍርባናቸውም ሁሉ፥ የኀጢአታቸውም መሥዋዕት ሁሉ፥ የበደላቸውም መሥዋዕት ሁሉ፥ ከተቀደሰውም ሁሉ ለአንተ ለልጆችህም ይሆናል።
በቅዱሰ ቅዱሳን ብሉት፤ ወንዶች ሁሉ ይብሉት፤ አንተም ልጆችህም ብሉት፤ ለአንተ የተቀደሰ ነውና።
ይህም ለእናንተ ነው፤ የእስራኤል ልጆች ለስጦታ ያቀረቡትን የመጀመሪያ ቍርባን ሁሉ ለአንተ ከአንተም ጋር ለወንዶችና ለሴቶች ልጆችህ የዘለዓለም ሕግ እንዲሆን ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤ በቤትህ ውስጥ ንጹሕ የሆነ ሁሉ ይብላው።
ለእግዚአብሔር ከሚሰጡት የፍሬ መጀመሪያ ከዘይትና ከወይን ከስንዴም የተመረጠውን ሁሉ ለአንተ ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤
ወደ እግዚአብሔር የሚያመጡት በምድራቸው ያለው የፍሬ መጀመሪያ ሁሉ ለአንተ ይሆናል፤ በቤትህ ውስጥ ንጹሕ የሆነ ሁሉ ይብላው፤
በእስራኤል ልጆች ዘንድ የተከለከለው ሁሉ ለአንተ ይሆናል።
ከሰው እስከ እንስሳ ቢሆን፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ከሚያቀርቡት ሥጋ ሁሉ፥ መጀመሪያ የሚወለድ ሁሉ ለአንተ ይሆናል፤ ነገር ግን የሰውን በኵራት ፈጽሞ ትቤዠዋለህ፤ ያልነጹትንም እንስሳት በኵራት ትቤዣለህ።
አንድ ወር የሆነው ልጅ ዋጋው በቤተ መቅደስ ሚዛን አምስት ሰቅል ነው። ይኸውም ሃያ አቦሊ ነው።
ነገር ግን የላሞቹን በኵራት፥ ወይም የበጎቹን በኵራት፥ የፍየሎችንም በኵራት አትቤዥም፤ ቅዱሳን ናቸውና፤ ደማቸውን በመሠዊያው ላይ ትረጨዋለህ፤ ስባቸውንም ለእግዚአብሔር በጎ መዓዛ እንዲሆን መሥዋዕት ታደርገዋለህ።
And the flesh shall be unto thee; as the offerings that are presented, so shall it be unto thee as the moon of the month.

The children of Israel shall give unto the Lord all that is holy unto thee; I have given them unto thee, along with thy sons and thy daughters. This shall be a perpetual statute before the Lord for thee and for thy descendants after thee.
And the Lord said unto Aaron, “Thou shalt not have an inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them; for I am thy portion and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.”

sections.title: The portion of the Levites from the offering.

verses.text: "Behold, unto the children of Levi, I have given the tithe of the children of Israel for their service in the tabernacle of witness; therefore, I have granted them a heritage of ten portions."
"And henceforth, let it not be that they shall incur sin unto death; let not the children of Israel approach the tabernacle of witness."

"But the Levites shall perform the service of the tabernacle of witness; and they shall bear their iniquity; it shall be a perpetual statute for your generations; and among the children of Israel, they shall not inherit a portion."

"To the Levites, I have given the tithe of the children of Israel as their inheritance, for their service which they perform in the tabernacle of witness; therefore, among the children of Israel, let them not inherit a portion."

sections.title: The Levites shall be given ten.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,

"Speak unto the Levites, and say unto them: 'When ye take of the tithe of the children of Israel, which I have given unto you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up a heave offering of it for the Lord, even a tenth part of the tithe.'
And your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you as though it were the grain of the threshing floor and as the fullness of the winepress.
Thus shall ye also offer a heave offering unto the Lord of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the Lord's heave offering unto Aaron the priest.
Of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the Lord, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.
Therefore thou shalt say unto them: 'When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the grain of the threshing floor and as the fullness of the winepress.'
And ye and your households shall eat in the presence of the Lord, for it is your reward in your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.
And when ye have heaved the best thereof from it, it shall not be imputed unto you as sin; and ye shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.'"

sections.title: The ordinance of the sin offering that is performed in the place of the altar.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses and Aaron, saying:
"The commandment of the law which the Lord hath commanded is this: concerning the clean and the unclean, and the unburdened, and the unladen, that ye shall speak unto the children of Israel."
"And thou shalt give her unto the priest, unto Eleazar; she shall be brought forth without the camp unto a clean place; and before him shall she be slain."
"And Eleazar shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times."
"And he shall burn the heifer before his eyes; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, and her dung shall he burn."
"And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast them into the midst of the burning of the heifer."
"And the priest shall wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in water; and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening."
"And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening."

"And a clean person shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation; it is a purification for sin."

"And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening; and it shall be a statute forever unto the children of Israel and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them."

sections.title: Concerning the law that is to be fulfilled with great trembling.

verses.text: "The corpse that is touched shall be unclean for seven days."
"Thus, on the third day and on the seventh day, he shall be cleansed; he shall be clean. However, if he does not cleanse himself on the third day and on the seventh day, he shall not be clean."

"The corpse that is touched shall not be cleansed, and he has defiled the sanctuary of the Lord; that man shall be cut off from Israel, for the water of purification has not been sprinkled upon him, and he is unclean; his uncleanness is still upon him."
"If a man dies in a tent, this is the law: all who enter the tent and all who are in the tent shall be unclean for seven days."
"Every open vessel which has no covering is unclean."
"In the field, if one is slain, or if a corpse is touched, or if a human bone is touched, or if a grave is touched, he shall be unclean for seven days."
"For the unclean, he shall take from the ashes of the burnt heifer and running water shall be added to them in a vessel; and in the vessel, the water shall be sprinkled."

"And the clean person shall take hyssop and dip it in the water and sprinkle it upon the tent and upon all the vessels and upon the persons who were there, and upon the one who touched a bone or the slain or the dead or the grave."

"The clean shall sprinkle it upon the unclean on the third day and on the seventh day; on the seventh day, he shall cleanse him; he shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and he shall be clean by evening."

"And if the man is unclean and does not cleanse himself, that man has defiled the sanctuary of the Lord, and he shall be cut off from the congregation, for the water of purification has not been sprinkled upon him, and he is unclean."
This shall be a law for you throughout your generations; the water that cleanses shall be poured upon the one who is unclean, and the water that cleanses shall remain unclean until the evening.
And every matter that is unclean shall be unclean; and the person who is unclean shall remain unclean until the evening.

sections.title: The Lord shall pour forth water upon the people as He hath poured forth rain.

verses.text: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ በመጀመሪያው ወር ወደ ጺን ምድረ በዳ መጡ፤ ሕዝቡም በቃዴስ ተቀመጡ፤ ማርያምም በዚያ ሞተች፤ ተቀበረችም።
ለማኅበሩም ውኃ አልነበረም፤ ሕዝቡም በሙሴና በአሮን ላይ ተሰበሰቡ።
ሙሴንም ተጣሉት፤ እንዲህም ብለው ተናገሩት፥ “ወንድሞቻችን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሞቱ ጊዜ እኛም ምነው በሞትን ኖሮ፤
እኛ፥ ከብቶቻችንም በዚያ እንሞት ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔርን ማኅበር ወደዚህ ምድረ በዳ ለምን አወጣችሁ?
ዘር ወደማይዘራበት፥ በለስና ወይንም፥ ሮማንም፥ የሚጠጣም ውኃ ወደሌለበት ወደዚህ ክፉ ስፍራ ታመጡን ዘንድ ከግብፅ ለምን አወጣችሁን?”
ሙሴና አሮንም ከማኅበሩ ፊት ወደ ምስክሩ ድንኳን ዳጃፍ ሄደው በግንባራቸው ወደቁ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ተገለጠላቸው።
እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው፦
“ይህችን በትርህን ውሰድ፤ አንተና ወንድምህ አሮንም ማኅበሩን ሰብስቡ፤ ዐለቷንም በፊታቸው እዘዟት፤ ውኃ ትሰጣለች፤ ከድንጋይዋም ውኃ ታወጡላቸዋላችሁ፤ እንዲሁም ማኅበሩን፥ ከብቶቻቸውንም ታጠጡላቸዋላችሁ።”
ሙሴም እግዚአብሔር እንደ አዘዘው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የነበረችውን በትሩን ወሰደ።
ሙሴና አሮንም ማኅበሩን በዐለቷ ፊት ሰብስበው፥ “እናንተ ዓመፀኞች፥ እንግዲህ ስሙ፤ በውኑ ከዚህች ዐለት ውኃን እናወጣላችሁ ነበር?” አሏቸው።
And Moses struck the rock twice with his hand, and much water came forth; and the congregation and their beasts drank.

And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying, “Because you did not believe in Me to sanctify Me in the sight of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”
The children of Israel contended with him, and thus this water was called the water of contention. And it was made evident that He was holy through this water of contention.

sections.title: Because the king of Edom would not allow the children of Israel to pass through his land, he guarded against them.

verses.text: And Moses sent messengers from the wilderness to the king of Edom, saying, “Thus says your brother Israel: You know all the hardship that has befallen us;
Our fathers went down to Egypt, and we dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians dealt harshly with us and our fathers.
And we cried out to the Lord, and the Lord heard our voice; and He sent an angel and brought us out of Egypt; and behold, we are in your territory, at the city that is on the edge of your land.

Let us pass through your land; we will not pass through field or vineyard, nor will we drink water from a well; we will go along the king's highway; we will not turn aside to the right hand or to the left until we have passed through your territory.”
But the king of Edom said, “You shall not pass through my land, lest I come out against you with the sword.”
And the children of Israel said to him, “We will go by the highway; and if I or my livestock drink any of your water, then I will pay for it; there is no need for us to do anything else.”
Yet he said, “You shall not pass through.” So the king of Edom came out against them with many men and with a strong hand.
Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his territory; so Israel turned away from him.

sections.title: The Death of Aaron

verses.text: And they journeyed from Kadesh; and all the children of Israel dwelt in Mount Hor.
And the Lord spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Edom, by the border of Mount Hor, saying,
"Let Aaron be gathered unto his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah."
Bring Aaron and his son Eleazar unto the top of Mount Hor before the eyes of the congregation.
And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon his son Eleazar; and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people, and there he shall die."
And Moses did as the Lord commanded; and they went up to Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon his son Eleazar; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.
And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

sections.title: The victory that was found upon the Canaanites.

verses.text: በአዜብ በኩል ተቀምጦ የነበረው ከነዓናዊው የአራድ ንጉሥ በአታሪን መንገድ እስራኤል እንደ መጡ ሰማ፤ ከእስራኤልም ጋር ሰልፍ አደረገ ከእነርሱም ምርኮ ማረከ።
እስራኤልም ለእግዚአብሔር፥ “ይህን ሕዝብ አሳልፈህ በእጃችን ብትሰጠን እርሱንና ከተሞቹን ሕርም ብለን እናጠፋዋለን” ብለው ስእለት ተሳሉ።
እግዚአብሔርም የእስራኤልን ድምፅ ሰማ፤ ከነዓናውያንንም አሳልፎ በእጃቸው ሰጣቸው፤ እነርሱንም፥ ከተሞቻቸውንም ሕርም ብለው አጠፉአቸው፤ የዚያን ስፍራ ስም “ሕርም” ብለው ጠሩት።

sections.title: The cunning serpent and the serpent made of brass.

verses.text: And they journeyed from the mountain of Hor by the way of the Red Sea, and they compassed the land of Edom; and the people were much discouraged because of the way.

And the people spake against God and against Moses, saying, “Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in this wilderness? For there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.”
And the Lord sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.

Therefore the people came to Moses and said, “We have sinned, for we have spoken against the Lord and against thee; pray unto the Lord, that he take away the serpents from us.” And Moses prayed for the people.
And the Lord said unto Moses, “Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole; and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.”
And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole; and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.

sections.title: And the journey that was made unto the land of Moab.

verses.text: And the children of Israel journeyed; and they encamped in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan, near Jericho.
From thence they journeyed and encamped in the wilderness, which is before Moab, on the east side of the sun’s rising, in the valley of the plains.
And they journeyed from there and encamped by the brook Zered.
And they journeyed from there and encamped in the wilderness that is before the border of the Amorites, by the river Arnon; for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
Therefore it is said in the Book, “The Lord’s war has been proclaimed against the cities of the Amorites and the brooks of Arnon.”
And he who descends to the dwelling of the Ar, and he who touches the border of Moab, shall stand still by the waters of the brooks.
And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, “Gather the people together, and I will give them water.” And they went to the well that was spoken of.
And at that time Israel sang this song by the well, and they began to sing concerning the well:
“Spring up, O well!”
And from there they journeyed to the place called Matanah; and from Matanah they journeyed to Nahaliel, and from Nahaliel to Bamoth;

And they journeyed from the wilderness of Moab, and they looked towards the wilderness, and they turned their faces towards the mountain of Pisgah, which is in the land of Moab, and they went to the valley of the son of Jamin.

sections.title: And there was a victory that was found upon the queen's throne and upon the king's throne.

verses.text: And Israel sent messengers unto the king of the Amorites, unto Sihon, with words of peace, saying thus:

"Let us pass through thy land; we will go along by the highway; we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left; we will not drink of the water of thy well; we will go by the king's highway until we be past thy borders."

But Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border; but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness; and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.
And Israel took all these cities; and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.
For Heshbon was the city of Sihon, king of the Amorites; which had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.
Therefore the poets say,
"Fire came out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon."
Woe unto thee, Moab!
They were destroyed even unto Debon, from Heshbon.
And Israel dwelt in the cities of the Amorites.
And Moses sent the spies unto Jazer; and they took possession of it and its villages, and they utterly destroyed the inhabitants of the Amorites who were there.
And they turned back and went by the way of Bashan; and Og, the king of Bashan, came out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

And the Lord said unto Moses, “Fear him not; for I have delivered him and all his people and his land into thy hand; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon, the king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.”
And they smote him and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left alive; and they possessed his land.

sections.title: Balak sought to curse the children of Israel, as he called upon the diviner.

verses.text: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ተጓዙ፤ በኢያሪኮ በኩል በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ በሞዓብ ምዕራብም ሰፈሩ።
የሴፎር ልጅ ባላቅ እስራኤል በአሞሬዎናውያን ላይ ያደረገውን ሁሉ አየ።
ብዙም ነበረና ሞዓብ ከሕዝቡ እጅግ ፈራ፤ ከእስራኤልም ልጆች የተነሣ ሞዓብ ደነገጠ።
ሞዓብም የምድያምን ሽማግሌዎች፥ “በሬ የለመለመውን ሣር እንደሚጨርስ ይህ ሠራዊት በዙሪያችን ያለውን ሁሉ ይጨርሳል” አላቸው። በዚያን ጊዜ የሶፎር ልጅ ባላቅ የሞዓብ ንጉሥ ነበረ።
በወንዙም አጠገብ ባለችው በሕዝቡ ልጆች ምድር በፋቱራ ወደ ተቀመጠው ወደ ቢዖር ልጅ ወደ በለዓም፥ “እነሆ፥ ከግብፅ የወጣ ሕዝብ አለ፤
እነሆም፥ የምድሩን ሁሉ ፊት ሸፈነ፤ በአቅራቢያችንም ተቀምጦአል፤ አሁንም ይህ ሕዝብ ከእኔ ይበልጣልና ልወጋቸውና ከምድሪቱ ላሳድዳቸው እችል እንደ ሆነ፥ ና ርገምልኝ፤ አንተ የመረቅኸው ምሩቅ፥ የረገምኸውም ርጉም እንደ ሆነ አውቃለሁና” ብሎ ይጠሩት ዘንድ መልእክተኞችን ላከ።
የሞዓብ ሽማግሌዎችና የምድያም ሽማግሌዎችም የምዋርቱን ዋጋ በእጃቸው ይዘው ሄዱ፤ ወደ በለዓምም መጡ፤ የባላቅንም ቃል ነገሩት።
እርሱም፥ “ዛሬ ሌሊት በዚህ እደሩ፤ እግዚእብሔርም የሚነግረኝን እነግራችኋለሁ” አላቸው፤ የሞዓብ አለቆችም በበለዓም ዘንድ አደሩ።
እግዚአብሔርም ወደ በለዓም መጥቶ፥ “እነዚህ በአንተ ዘንድ ያሉ ሰዎች እነማን ናቸው?” አለው።
በለዓምም እግዚአብሔርን እንዲህ አለው፥ “የሞዓብ ንጉሥ የሶፎር ልጅ ባላቅ፦ እንዲህ ሲል ወደ እኔ ልኮአቸዋል፤

Behold, the people that came out of Egypt have covered the face of the earth; and they have settled near me; perhaps I shall be able to prevail against them, and drive them out, as it is now, and let him come to me.
And the Lord said unto Balaam, "Go not with them; for they are blessed, and thou shalt not curse the people."
And when Balaam rose up, the princes of Balak said unto him, "We cannot go with you, for the Lord hath not permitted us; go ye unto your lord."
And the princes of Moab arose and went to Balak, and said, "Balaam will not come with us."
And Balak sent yet again more princes, and more honorable than they.
And they came to Balaam, and said, "Balak the son of Zippor hath sent us unto thee, saying, 'I pray thee, let nothing hinder thee from coming unto me.'"
"For I will greatly honor thee, and whatsoever thou sayest unto me, I will do; come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people."
And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, "If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the Lord my God, to do less or more."
"Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the Lord will say unto me more."
And God came unto Balaam at night, and said, "If the men come to call thee, rise up, and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do."

sections.title: In the beginning and the end.

verses.text: And when Balaam arose, he saddled his donkey and went with the princes of Moab.
And the anger of the Lord was kindled because he went; and the angel of the Lord stood in the way to withstand him.

And he was riding upon his donkey, and his two servants were with him. And the donkey saw the angel of the Lord standing in the way with a drawn sword in his hand; and the donkey turned aside out of the way and went into the field; and Balaam smote the donkey to turn her into the way.
And the angel of the Lord stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side and a wall on that side.
And when the donkey saw the angel of the Lord, she thrust herself unto the wall and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall; and he smote her again.
And the angel of the Lord went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
And when the donkey saw the angel of the Lord, she fell down under Balaam; and Balaam's anger was kindled, and he smote the donkey with a staff.
And the Lord opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said unto Balaam, “What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?”
And Balaam said unto the donkey, “Because thou hast mocked me; I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.”
And the donkey said unto Balaam, “Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day? Was I ever wont to do so unto thee?” And he said, “Nay.”
እግዚአብሔርም የበለዓምን ዐይኖች ከፈተ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም መልአክ በመንገድ ላይ ቆሞ፥ የተመዘዘም ሰይፍ በእጁ ይዞ አየ፤ በግንባሩም ወድቆ ሰገደለት።
የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ፥ “አህያህን ሦስት ጊዜ ለምን መታህ? እነሆ፥ መንገድህ በፊቴ ቀና አልነበረምና ላሰናክልህ ወጥቼአለሁ፤
አህያዪቱም አይታኝ ከፊቴ ፈቀቅ አለች፤ ይህም ሦስተኛ ጊዜ ነው፤ ከፊቴስ ፈቀቅ ባላለች በእውነት አሁን አንተን በገደልሁህ፤ እርሷንም ባዳንኋት ነበር” አለው።
በለዓምም የእግዚአብሔርን መልአክ፥ “በድያለሁ፤ አንተ በመንገድ ላይ በፊቴ እንደ ቆምህብኝ አላወቅሁም፤ እንግዲህ አሁን አትወድድ እንደሆነ እመለሳለሁ” አለው።
የእግዚእብሔርም መልአክ በለዓምን፥ “ከሰዎቹ ጋር ሂድ፤ ነገር ግን የምናገርህን ቃል ብቻ ለመናገር ተጠንቀቅ” አለው። በለዓምም ከባላቅ አለቆች ጋር ሄደ።
“ባላቅም በለዓም እንደ መጣ በሰማ ጊዜ ከዳርቻዎች በአንደኛ ክፍል በአለችው በአርኖን ዳርቻ ወደ አለችው ወደ ሞዓብ ከተማ ሊገናኘው ወጣ።
ባላቅም በለዓምን፥ “አንተን ለመጥራት የላክሁብህ አይደለምን? ለምንስ ወደ እኔ አልመጣህም? አንተን ለማክበር እኔ አልችልምን?” አለው።
በለዓምም ባላቅን፥ “እነሆ፥ ወደ አንተ መጥቼአለሁ፤ አሁን አንዳችን ነገር ለመናገር እችላለሁን? እግዚአብሔር በአፌ የሚያደርገውን ቃል እርሱን እናገራለሁ” አለው።
በለዓምም ከባላቅ ጋር ሄደ፤ ወደ ቅጽር ግቢውም ገቡ።
ባላቅም በሬዎችንና በጎችን አርዶ ወደ በለዓም፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ወዳሉት አለቆች ላከ።
And in the evening, Balak took Balaam and brought him to the high places of Baal; and there he showed him the people of Israel.

sections.title: The First Prophecy of Balaam

verses.text: And Balaam said unto Balak, “Seven altars shall I prepare here; seven bullocks and seven rams shall I offer for thee.”
And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and he offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.

And Balaam said unto Balak, “Stand by thy burnt offerings, and I will go; peradventure the Lord will come to meet me, and whatsoever He showeth me I will tell thee.” And Balak stood by his burnt offerings, and Balaam went to seek the Lord.
And the Lord met Balaam; and Balaam said unto the Lord, “Behold, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.”
And the Lord put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, “Return unto Balak, and thus shalt thou speak.”
And he returned unto him; and behold, he and all the princes of Moab stood by his burnt offerings; and the Spirit of God came upon him.
And he took up his parable, and said:
“How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed?
For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him;
Behold, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.”
And Balak said unto Balaam, “What hast thou done unto me? I called thee to curse mine enemies, and behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.”
And Balaam answered and said unto Balak, “Must I not take heed to speak that which the Lord hath put in my mouth?”

sections.title: The Second Prophecy of Balaam

verses.text: And Balak said, “Please come with me to another place from which you may see them; you will see only a part of them, but all of them you shall not see; and from there, curse them for me.”
And he took him to the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
And Balaam said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offerings, while I go over there to meet the Lord.”
And the Lord met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”
And he came to him, and behold, he was standing beside his burnt offerings, and the princes of Moab were with him; and Balak said to Balaam, “What has the Lord spoken?”
He began to speak in parables, and said:
God is not a man that He should lie.
Behold, I have come; I will not return; I cannot go back.
There is no sorcery against Jacob, nor any divination against Israel.
The Lord brought him up out of Egypt.
There is no enchantment against Jacob;
Behold, the people rise up like a lioness;
And Balaam said to Balak, "Do not curse them at all, nor bless them at all."
And Balaam answered and said to Balak, "Did I not tell you that all that the Lord speaks, I must do?"

sections.title: The Third Prophecy of Balaam

verses.text: ባላቅም በለዓምን አለው፥ “ና፥ ወደ ሌላ ስፍራ እወስድሃለሁ፤ ምናልባት በዚህ ሆነህ እነርሱን ትረግምልኝ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ይወድድ ይሆናል።”
ባላቅም በለዓምን በምድረ በዳ ወደ ተከበበው ወደ ፌጎር ተራራ ወሰደው።
በለዓምም ባላቅን፥ “በዚህ ሰባት መሠዊያዎች ሥራልኝ፤ በዚህም ሰባት ወይፈን፥ ሰባትም አውራ በግ አዘጋጅልኝ” አለው።
ባላቅም በለዓም እንዳለው አደረገ፤ በየመሠዊያውም ላይ አንድ ወይፈንና አንድ አውራ በግ አሳረገ።
በለዓምም እስራኤልን መባረክ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መልካም እንደ ሆነ ባየ ጊዜ፥ እንደ ልማዱ ለማሟረት ወደ ፊት አልሄደም፤ ነገር ግን ወደ ምድረ በዳ ፊቱን መለሰ።
በለዓምም ዐይኑን አንሥቶ እስራኤል በየነገዳቸው ሲጓዙ አየ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በላዩ መጣ።
በምሳሌም ይናገር ጀመር፤ እንዲህም አለ፥ “የቢዖር ልጅ በለዓም እንዲህ ይላል፥ በትክክል የሚያይ ሰው እንዲህ ይላል፤
“የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል የሚሰማ፥
ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ ቤቶችህ፥
እንደሚጋርዱ ዛፎች፥
ከዘሩ ሰው ይወጣል፤
እግዚአብሔር ከግብፅ መርቶ አውጥቶታል፤
አርፎአል፥
ባላቅም በበለዓም ላይ ተቈጣ፤ እጆቹንም አጨበጨበ፤ ባላቅም በለዓምን አለው፦ ጠላቶችን ትረግም ዘንድ ጠራሁህ፥
እነሆም፥ ፈጽመህ መረቅሃቸው፤ ይህ ሦስተኛህ ነው፤ አሁንም እንግዲህ ወደ ስፍራህ ሂድ፤ እኔ አከብርሃለሁ ብዬ ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን እነሆ፥ ክብርህን ከለከለ።”
በለዓምም ባላቅን አለው፦
ባላቅ በቤቱ የሞላውን ብርና ወርቅ ቢሰጠኝ፥ መልካሙን ወይም ክፉውን ከልቤ ለማድረግ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እተላለፍ ዘንድ አይቻለኝም፤ እግዚአብሔር የተናገረውን እርሱን እናገራለሁ ብዬ ወደ እኔ ለላክሃቸው መልእክተኞችህ አልተናገርኋቸውምን?
አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ ወደ ሕዝቤ እሄዳለሁ፤ ና፥ ይህ ሕዝብ በኋለኛው ዘመን በሕዝብህ ላይ የሚያደርገውን እነግርሃለሁ።”

sections.title: The final prophecy of Balaam.

verses.text: በምሳሌም ይናገር ጀመር፥ እንዲህም አለ፦
የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል የሚሰማ፥
አየዋለሁ፥ አሁን ግን አይደለም፤
ኤዶምያስም ርስቱ ይሆናል፤
ከያዕቆብም ኀያል ሰው ይወጣል፤
ዐማሌቅንም አይቶ በምሳሌ ይናገር ጀመር፤ እንዲህም አለ፦
ቄኔዎናውያንንም አይቶ በምሳሌ ይናገር ጀመር፤ እንዲህም አለ፦
ቢዖር የጥፋት ጎጆ ቢሆንም አሦር ይማርክሃል።”
አግንም ባየው ጊዜ በምሳሌ ይናገር ጀመር፤ እንዲህም አለ፦
ከቄጤዎንም እጅ የሚወጣው
And Balaam arose; and he returned unto his place; and Balak also went his way to his house.

sections.title: The Moabites did unto the Israelites as the assailant.

verses.text: And Israel dwelt in Shittim; and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.
And they called the people unto their gods; and the people did eat and bowed down to their gods.
And Israel joined himself unto Baal-peor; and the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel.
And the Lord said unto Moses, “Take all the heads of the people and hang them up before the Lord against the sun, that the fierce anger of the Lord may be turned away from Israel.”
And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, “Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baal-peor.”

And behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation and took a javelin in his hand.
And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel and the woman through her belly; so the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.
And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying:

"Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned back My wrath from the children of Israel, in that he was zealous with My zeal among them, so that I did not consume the children of Israel in My jealousy."
"Therefore, behold, I give to him My covenant of peace."
"And it shall be to him and to his descendants after him a covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was zealous for his God and made atonement for the children of Israel."
"And the name of the Israelite who was killed, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a leader of a father's house among the Simeonites."
"And the name of the Midianite woman who was killed was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; she was the head of the people of a father's house in Midian."
"And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, 'Speak to the children of Israel, saying:'"
"Harass the Midianites, and strike them;"

"for they harassed you with their wiles, with which they seduced you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a leader of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague because of Peor.'"

sections.title: The second census of the children of Israel.

verses.text: And it came to pass that after the death of the priest, the Lord spoke unto Moses and unto Aaron's son, Eleazar, saying:
"From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel, thou shalt number them by their armies, thou and Aaron."
And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying:
"The Lord commanded Moses to number the people of Israel from twenty years old and upward." These are the children of Israel which came out of the land of Egypt.
Of the children of Israel, the tribe of Reuben; the children of Reuben; of the family of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of the family of Pallu, the family of the Palluites.
Of the family of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of the family of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
These are the families of the Reubenites; and they that were numbered of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred and thirty.
And the children of Pallu; Eliab.
And the children of Eliab; Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram; these are the renowned of the congregation, who strove against Moses and Aaron in the company of Korah.

And the congregation was gathered against them in the time of death; the earth opened her mouth and swallowed them up with Korah; and there died in that fire two hundred and fifty men; and they became a sign.
But the children of Korah did not die.
And the children of Simeon, by their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;
of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
These are the families of the Simeonites; their number was twenty-two thousand two hundred.
The children of Judah were Er and Onan; and Shelah; and Zarah. And Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
The children of Judah, by their families: of Shelah, the family of the Shelahites; of Pharez, the family of the Pharezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.
The children of Pharez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
These are the families of Judah; and they that were numbered of them were threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.
The children of Issachar, by their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Pua, the family of the Punites;
of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
These are the families of Issachar; and their numbered men were sixty-four thousand and four hundred.
The families of Zebulun, by their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
These are the families of Zebulun; and their numbered men were sixty-five thousand and five hundred.
The children of Gad, by their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;
of Ezbon, the family of the Ezbonites; of Saphon, the family of the Saphonites;
of Arohad, the family of the Arohadites; of Areli, the family of the Areliites.
These are the families of the children of Gad; and their numbered men were forty-four thousand and five hundred.
The children of Asher, by their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnahites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Beriahites.
Of the children of Heber: of the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah.
These are the descendants of Asher; and of them were counted forty-three thousand four hundred.
The children of Joseph by their families; Manasseh and Ephraim.
The children of Manasseh; of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir begat Gilead; and Gilead begat the family of the Gileadites.
These are the children of Gilead; of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;
of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;
of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
And the son of Hepher was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had no sons, but daughters; and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
These are the families of Manasseh; and those that were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
These are the children of Ephraim by their families; of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
These are the children of Shuthelah; of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
These are the children of Ephraim, their clans; and those counted among them were thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the children of Joseph by their clans.
The children of Benjamin by their clans; from Bela, the clan of the Belaites; from Ashbel, the clan of the Ashbelites; from Ahiram, the clan of the Ahiramites;
from Shophan, the clan of the Shophanites;
The children of Bela were Ard and Naaman; from Ard, the clan of the Ardites; and from Naaman, the clan of the Naamites.
These are the children of Benjamin by their clans. Those counted among them were forty-five thousand six hundred.
These are the children of Dan by their clans; from Shuham, the clan of the Shuhamites; these are the children of Dan by their clans.
All the clans of the Shuhamites numbered sixty-four thousand four hundred.
The children of Naphtali by their clans; from Jahzeel, the clan of the Jahzeelites; from Guni, the clan of the Gunites;
from Jezer, the clan of the Jezerites; from Shillem, the clan of the Shillemites.
These are the clans of the children of Naphtali by their clans. Those counted among them were forty-five thousand four hundred.
These are the names of the children of Israel who were counted: six hundred and one thousand seven hundred and thirty.
And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
"To these, the land shall be divided by their names; according to the number of their names, the land shall be inherited."
"To the many, thou shalt give much inheritance; and to the few, thou shalt give little inheritance; to each according to their number shall their inheritance be given."
Nevertheless, the land shall be divided by lot according to their names; as their fathers inherited, so shall they inherit.
Among the many and the few, thou shalt divide their inheritance by lot.
These are the names of the children of Levi according to their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
These are the families of the Levites: the family of Libni, the family of Hebron, the family of Machli, the family of Shimi,
the family of Korah, the family of the Qehathites. And Amram took Jochebed, his father's sister, to wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
And unto Aaron were born Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
In the wilderness of Sinai, before the Lord, when other fire was offered, Nadab and Abihu died.

From the beginning of one month and thereafter, all the men who were counted among them were thirty-three thousand. And among the children of Israel, no inheritance was given to them, nor were they counted with the children of Israel.
On the plain of Moab, by the Jordan near Jericho, as they were counted, these are the children of Israel whom Moses and the priest Eleazar counted.
However, when Moses and Aaron the priest counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai, not one man was found among them.
The Lord spoke concerning them, saying, "Truly, they shall die in the wilderness." Except for Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun, not one man remained among them.

sections.title: The daughters of Zelophehad came forward with a request.

verses.text: From the sons of Joseph, from the tribe of Manasseh, the son of Machir, the son of Gilead, the son of Hepher, the daughters of Zelophehad came; and the names of these daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
And they stood before Moses and Eleazar the priest, and before the leaders and all the congregation, saying,
"Our fathers died in the wilderness; they were not in the company of those who gathered together against the Lord in the company of Korah, but died in their own sin, and they had no sons."
And if a man dies and has no son, why should the name of our father be removed from among his family?
"Give us a possession among the brothers of our father." And Moses brought their case before the Lord.
And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
"The daughters of Zelophehad speak what is right; you shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brothers, and cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.
And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying: If a man dies and has no son, then you shall give his inheritance to his daughter;
And if he has no daughter, you shall give his inheritance to his brothers;
And if his brothers are not available, then you shall give his inheritance to his father's brothers.

"If there be no brothers of your father, you shall give the inheritance to his nearest kin; and he shall inherit it. And the Lord commanded Moses to establish a statute and judgment for the children of Israel."

sections.title: Jesus was chosen as Moses was appointed.

verses.text: And the Lord said unto Moses, “Go up unto this mountain, Abarim, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession.
And in that day, thy brother Aaron shall be gathered unto his people; for he shall be joined unto his kin, and thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people.

Ye have provoked the Lord to anger in the wilderness; ye have not hearkened unto His voice, and therefore ye shall not enter into the land which He hath sworn to give you. This is the water of Meribah, where the children of Israel strove with the Lord.”
And Moses spake unto the Lord, saying:

“The God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over this congregation, which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the Lord be not as sheep which have no shepherd.”
And the Lord said unto Moses, “Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;
And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.
And the children of Israel shall be gathered before thee, and they shall give him their obedience.

And Eleazar the priest shall stand before the Lord for him, to ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the Lord; at his word shall they go out, and at his word shall they come in, both he and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”
And Moses did as the Lord commanded him; and he brought forth Joshua and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.
And the Lord commanded Moses, saying, "Lay your hand upon him and set him before Eleazar the priest." Thus he commanded.

sections.title: The offerings of the season.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,
"Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel: 'You shall offer unto Me your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, and your goodly gifts on the appointed days; keep them in watch.'"

And thus He said unto them: "This is the offering which ye shall present unto the Lord by fire; it is a burnt offering for the day of the week, two lambs of the first year without blemish, day by day shall ye offer them."
One lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at evening;
And for the grain offering, ye shall present the fourth part of an ephah of fine flour mingled with the third part of a hin of oil, for the sweet savor, a memorial offering unto the Lord.
The burnt offering which is presented unto the Lord by fire shall be of the flock, a lamb without blemish, prepared on the altar of the mountain of Sinai, a continual burnt offering.
The drink offering shall be of the fourth part of an hin for one lamb; within the sanctuary shall ye offer the drink offering unto the Lord.
And the other lamb shall ye offer at evening; and the grain offering and the drink offering shall ye offer in the morning, that it may be a sweet savor unto the Lord, a burnt offering continually.

sections.title: The offerings of the Sabbath.

verses.text: "On the Sabbath day, you shall offer two lambs of the first year without blemish, for a burnt offering, and a grain offering of fine flour mingled with oil, a tenth part of an ephah; and the drink offering shall be offered with it."
"This is the offering that you shall present every Sabbath, besides the continual burnt offering and its drink offering."

sections.title: The offering that is presented at the altar.

verses.text: "In the month of your offering, you shall present a sacrifice to the Lord; two lambs of the first year, one male and one female, without blemish, seven days of the one year old lambs, which are the offerings of the flock."

"For each, and for the grain offering, you shall prepare fine flour mixed with oil, three-tenths of an ephah for the male lamb, and for the female lamb, you shall prepare fine flour mixed with oil, two-tenths of an ephah."

"For each goat, for the grain offering, you shall prepare fine flour mixed with oil, two-tenths of an ephah; and for the sacrifice that is to be offered to the Lord, it shall be a pleasing aroma, and you shall present it by fire."

"And their drink offerings shall be half a hin for one male lamb, and for the female lamb, a quarter of a hin; and for one goat, a fourth of a hin of wine shall be offered; this is the monthly offering for all the sacrifices that are to be offered each month."
"And for the Lord, as a sin offering, you shall present one male goat; it shall be in addition to the regular sacrifice and the drink offerings."

sections.title: And the offerings that are to be presented during the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread.

verses.text: "In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the Passover of the Lord."
"And on the fifteenth day of this month, there shall be a feast; you shall eat unleavened bread for seven days."
"The first day shall be a holy convocation for you; you shall do no work on that day."
"And you shall offer to the Lord your burnt offerings made by fire; two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs of the first year, without blemish shall be to you."
"And their grain offering shall be of fine flour mixed with oil; for one bull, you shall offer three-tenths of an ephah, and for the ram, two-tenths of an ephah."
"And for the seven lambs, you shall offer one-tenth of an ephah for each lamb."
"And one kid of the goats as a sin offering shall be offered for you."
"Besides the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, you shall offer these."
"And you shall offer to the Lord a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, for seven days, day by day, as a pleasing aroma to the Lord; besides the continual burnt offering and its drink offering."
"On the seventh day, there shall be a holy convocation for you; you shall do no work on that day."

sections.title: The offering presented on the feast of unleavened bread.

verses.text: "On the day of the Feast of Weeks, when you bring the new grain offering unto the Lord at your appointed times, it shall be a holy day unto you; you shall do no work therein."
"And unto the Lord, you shall offer a good sacrifice, that which is without blemish; two young bulls from the herd, one ram, and seven male lambs of the first year, without blemish."
"For the grain offering, you shall prepare fine flour mixed with oil, for each shall be three-tenths of an ephah; and for one ram, you shall prepare two-tenths of an ephah."
"And for the seven lambs, you shall offer one-tenth of an ephah for each lamb according to the prescribed measure."
"And for your sin offering, you shall offer one young bull as a sin offering to make atonement for you."
"In addition to the regular burnt offering and the grain offering, you shall offer them and their drink offerings; they shall be without blemish."

sections.title: The offering that is presented on the feast of the new moon.

verses.text: "And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, this day shall be unto you a holy day; ye shall do no servile work therein; it shall be a day of blowing of trumpets unto you."

"For the Lord, a burnt offering shall be made, which is to be without blemish; one bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year without blemish shall be offered, with their meat offerings and their drink offerings, according to the number of the days of the year."
"For the fine flour mingled with oil, for the bullock three tenths of an ephah, for the ram two tenths of an ephah,"
"And for the seven lambs, ye shall offer one tenth of an ephah for each lamb according to the ordinance."
"And for your sin offering, ye shall offer one kid of the goats for a sin offering, to make atonement for you."
"And besides the burnt offering of the month, and his meat offering, and the daily burnt offering, according to their ordinance, shall be offered unto the Lord, a sweet savor, by fire."

sections.title: An offering presented on the day of atonement for sin.

verses.text: "And this month shall be unto you the beginning of months; it shall be the first month of the year to you. Ye shall eat no leavened bread; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread."

"And unto the Lord shall be a good offering, that which is to be offered, one bullock of the herd, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish shall ye offer unto you; they shall be without spot."
"For the fine flour of your oblation shall be mingled with oil; for the bullock, three tenths of an ephah; for the ram, two tenths of an ephah;"
"And for the seven lambs, one tenth of an ephah shall be for each lamb;"

"For the sin offering, ye shall offer one kid of the goats; and for the trespass offering, ye shall offer one ram without blemish. And for the continual burnt offering, and for the oblation, and for the drink offerings, ye shall offer them according to their due."

sections.title: The offerings presented on the day of the feast.

verses.text: "And in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, it shall be a holy day for you; you shall do no work; but on the seventh day, make a feast unto the Lord your God."

"And for the Lord, let there be a good offering, that which is to be sacrificed, three bullocks, two rams, and four lambs of the first year without blemish shall be offered; they shall be without defect."
"And for the grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil, for each of the three bullocks, three-tenths of an ephah; for the two rams, two-tenths of an ephah for each;"
"For the four lambs, for each one, a tenth of an ephah shall be the requirement."

"And for the sin offering, you shall offer one male goat; it shall be in addition to the regular burnt offering and the grain offering, and the drink offerings shall be other than those that are regularly offered."
"And on the second day, two bullocks, two rams, and four lambs of the first year without blemish shall be offered;"
"For the bullocks and for the rams, and for the lambs, their grain offerings and their drink offerings shall be according to their number, as prescribed by the law."

"And for the sin offering, you shall offer one male goat; it shall be in addition to the regular burnt offering and the grain offering, and their drink offerings shall be other than those that are regularly offered."
"And on the third day, one bullock, two rams, and four lambs of the first year without blemish shall be offered;"
"For the bullocks and for the rams, and for the lambs, their grain offerings and their drink offerings shall be according to their number, as prescribed by their law."
For the sin offering, you shall bring one unblemished male goat, in addition to the regular burnt offering and the grain offering, and the drink offering shall be offered as prescribed.
"On the fourth day, ten bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs without blemish shall be offered as a single year's sacrifice of the flock."
For the bulls and the rams, and for the lambs, their grain offering and their drink offering shall be according to their number, as prescribed by their law.
For the sin offering, you shall bring one unblemished male goat, in addition to the regular burnt offering and the grain offering, and the drink offering shall be offered as prescribed.
"On the fifth day, nine bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs without blemish shall be offered as a single year's sacrifice of the flock."
For the bulls and the rams, and for the lambs, their grain offering and their drink offering shall be according to their number, as prescribed by their law.
For the sin offering, you shall bring one unblemished male goat, in addition to the regular burnt offering and the grain offering, and the drink offering shall be offered as prescribed.
"On the sixth day, eight bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs without blemish shall be offered as a single year's sacrifice of the flock."
For the bulls and the rams, and for the lambs, their grain offering and their drink offering shall be according to their number, as prescribed by their law.
For the sin offering, you shall bring one unblemished male goat, in addition to the regular burnt offering and the grain offering, and the drink offering shall be offered as prescribed.
"And on the seventh day, there shall be seven bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs without blemish, as a burnt offering for one year, of the flock."
"For the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, their grain offering and their drink offering shall be according to their number, as prescribed by their law."
"And for sin offerings, one male goat shall be offered; besides the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, and its drink offering, you shall offer another."
"And the eighth day shall be a holy convocation for you; you shall not do any ordinary work."
"For the Lord, there shall be a burnt offering, a bull, a ram, and seven lambs without blemish, as a burnt offering for one year from the flock."
"Their grain offering and their drink offering shall be for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, according to their number, as prescribed by their law."
"And for sin offerings, one male goat shall be offered; besides the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, and its drink offering, they shall be additional offerings."

"And these, from your livestock and from your flocks, as you may offer, for the burnt offerings, for the grain offering, for the drink offerings, and for your peace offerings, you shall present to the Lord during your appointed feasts."
"And Moses spoke to the children of Israel all that the Lord had commanded him."

sections.title: Concerning the ordinance given regarding the creation.

verses.text: ሙሴም ለእስራኤል ልጆች ነገዶች አለቆች እንዲህ ብሎ ነገራቸው፥ “እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘው ነገር ይህ ነው።
ሰው ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ስእለት ቢሳል፥ ወይም መሐላን ቢምል፤ ራሱንም ቢለይ፥ ቃሉን አያርክስ፤ ከአፉ እንደ ወጣው ሁሉ ያድርግ።
ሴትም ደግሞ ለእግዚአብሔር ስእለት ብትሳል፥ እርስዋም በአባቷ ቤት ሳለች በብላቴንነቷ ጊዜ ራስዋን ብትለይ፥
አባቷም ስእለቷንና ራስዋን የለየችበትን ቢሰማ፥ አባቷም ዝም ቢላት፥ ስእለቷ ሁሉ ይጸናል፤ ራስዋንም ያሰረችበት መሐላ ሁሉ ይጸናል።
አባቷ ግን በሰማበት ቀን ቢከለክላት፥ ስእለቷ፥ ራስዋንም ያሰረችበት መሐላዋ አይጸኑም፤ አባቷ ከልክሎአታልና እግዚአብሔር ይቅር ይላታል።
“ባል ያገባች ብትሆን፥ በአንደበቷም እንደ ተናገረች ስለ ራስዋ የተሳለችው ስእለት በራስዋ ላይ ቢሆን፥
ባልዋም ቢሰማ፥ በሰማበትም ቀን ዝም ቢላት፥ ስእለቷ፥ ራስዋንም ያሰረችበት መሐላ ይጸናሉ።
ባልዋ ግን በሰማበት ቀን ቢከለክላት፥ ስእለቷና ራስዋን ያሰረችበት መሐላ አይጸኑም፤ ባልዋ ከልክሎአታልና፤ እግዚአብሔርም ይቅር ይላታል።
“ባልዋ የሞተባት ወይም የተፋታች ግን ስእለቷና ራስዋን ያሰረችበት መሐላ ይጸኑባታል።
ሴትም በባልዋ ቤት ሳለች ብትሳል፥ ወይም ራስዋን በመሐላ ብታስር፥
If her husband hears and remains silent, and if he does not restrain her, then all her vows and every binding oath upon her shall stand.
But if her husband on the day that he hears her vows restrains her, then her vows or the bond upon her shall not stand; her husband has restrained her, and the Lord will forgive her.
"Every vow of hers, and every binding oath by which she has bound her soul, her husband shall confirm it; or her husband shall annul it."
However, if he remains silent on the day he hears, then he confirms all her vows, and every bond upon her; he has remained silent on the day he hears, therefore he bears her iniquity.
But if he annuls them after he has heard, he shall bear her iniquity."
She, while in her father's house in her youth, between her father and her husband, or between husband and wife, this is the ordinance that the Lord commanded Moses.

sections.title: The war that was waged against the Midianites.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
"Set apart the children of Israel from the Midianites; and after that, thou shalt gather unto thy people."
And Moses spake unto the people, saying, "Appoint men from among you; let them go forth to war against Midian, and let them be avenged of the Lord against Midian."
And from all the children of Israel, there were chosen a thousand of every tribe to go to war."
And from Israel's warriors, a thousand of each tribe were numbered; and those who were sent to battle were twelve thousand.
And Moses sent a thousand from each tribe, along with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, with the holy vessels and the trumpets of alarm in their hands.
And the Lord commanded Moses, and they fought against Midian; and they slew all the males.
And they killed the kings of Midian in that battle; and the five kings of Midian were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba; and they also slew Balaam the son of Beor with the sword in that battle.
And they took captive the women and children of Midian, and all their cattle and goods, and all their wealth and strength they seized.
And they burned with fire all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their encampments.
And they brought unto him all their cattle, both of man and beast, and all that they had in abundance.
They brought the offerings of the spoil and the offerings of the firstfruits unto Moses and unto Aaron and unto Eleazar, and unto the children of Israel, at the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

sections.title: The return of the army from battle.

verses.text: And Moses and Aaron, along with all the leaders of the congregation, went out to meet them outside the camp.
And Moses was angry with the officers of the army, with the captains and the rulers over thousands and over hundreds, who had come from the battle.
And Moses said to them, “Why have you spared all the women?

Behold, they are the ones who caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the Lord in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the Lord.
Now therefore, kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known a man intimately.
But keep alive for yourselves all the young girls who have not known a man intimately.
And you shall remain outside the camp for seven days; whoever has killed any person and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves and your captives on the third day and on the seventh day.
And as for your garments, and all that is made of leather, and all that is made of goat's hair, and all things made of wood, you shall purify them.”
And Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who had gone to battle, “This is the ordinance of the law which the Lord commanded Moses:
Gold and silver, bronze, iron, tin, and lead,

Every matter that can be purified by fire shall be clean; however, that which cannot be purified by fire shall be cleansed with water. You shall be cast away by water that which cannot be purified by fire.
On the seventh day, you shall wash your garments; and you shall be clean; thereafter, you shall approach the camp.

sections.title: As they were gathered together.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
"Thou and Aaron thy brother, and the leaders of the congregation, shall number the people and the cattle."
"And the offering shall be made by those who go forth to the war, and in the midst of the congregation shall you divide it."
"From among those who go forth to the war, and from those who go to the battle, from men and from cattle, from the goats and from the sheep, you shall offer unto the Lord one out of five hundred."
"And from their portion, you shall give a tribute unto the Lord for the priest, for Eleazar."

"And from the children of Israel's portion, from men and from cattle, from the goats and from the sheep, from all the beasts, you shall take one out of fifty; and you shall give it to the Levites, who keep the charge of the tabernacle of the Lord."
And Moses and Aaron did as the Lord commanded Moses.
And of those who went to the battle, the offering that remained was thus: six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep;
two thousand seven hundred goats;
one thousand six hundred cattle;
And the men, not knowing, were thirty-two thousand souls.
In the time that was, there were three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep, which were the portion of the people.
And from the sheep, the offering of the Lord was six hundred seventy-five.
And there were thirty-six thousand oxen; and the offering of the Lord was seven two.
And the goats were thirty-five thousand; and the offering of the Lord was sixty-one.
And the people were sixty-six thousand; and the offering of the Lord was thirty-two.
And the Lord commanded Moses, saying: "Give the offering that is due to the Lord to the priest, to Eleazar."
And among the children of Israel, there was no distinction made by Moses concerning the men who went to war.
The portion of the congregation was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred goats,
thirty-six thousand oxen.
ሠላሳ ሺህ አምስት መቶ አህዮች፥
ዐሥራ ስድስት ሺህ ሰዎች ነበሩ።
ሙሴ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ድርሻ ከሰውና ከእንስሳ ከሃምሳ አንድ ወሰደ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው የእግዚአብሔርን ድንኳን ሥርዐት ለሚጠብቁ ሌዋውያን ሰጠ።
በሠራዊት አእላፋት ላይ የተሾሙት አለቆች፥ ሻለቆችና የመቶ አለቆች ወደ ሙሴ ቀረቡ፤ ሙሴንም እንዲህ አሉት፦
“ባሪያዎችህ ወደ ሰልፍ የወጡትን ከእጃችን በታች ያሉትን ቈጠሩ፤ ከእኛም አንድ አልጐደለም።
ሰውም ሁሉ ከአገኘው ከወርቅ ዕቃ፥ ከእግር አልቦም፥ ከአምባርም፥ ከቀለበትም ከጕትቻም፥ ከድሪውም ስለ እኛ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ታስተሰርዩልን ዘንድ ለእግዚአብሔር መባ አምጥተናል” አሉት።
ሙሴና ካህኑ አልዓዛርም ወርቁንና በልዩ ልዩ የተሠራውን ዕቃ ሁሉ ከእጃቸው ተቀበሉ።
ከሻለቆችና ከመቶ አለቆች ለእግዚአብሔር የለዩትና ያቀረቡት ወርቅ ሁሉ ዐሥራ ስድስት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ አምሳ ሰቅል ነበረ።
ወደ ሰልፍ የወጡ ሰዎች ሁሉ የማረኩትን ለየራሳቸው ወሰዱ።
ሙሴና ካህኑ አልዓዛርም ወርቁን ከሻለቆችና ከመቶ አለቆች ወሰዱ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ለእስራኤል ልጆች መታሰቢያ ወደ ምስክሩ ድንኳን አገቡት።

sections.title: The things that were delivered from the east of the Jordan.

verses.text: ለሮቤል ልጆችና ለጋድ ልጆች እጅግ ብዙ እንስሶች ነበሩአቸው፤ እነሆም፥ የኢያዜር ምድርና የገለዓድ ምድር የከብት ሀገር እንደ ነበረ አዩ።
የሮቤል ልጆችና የጋድ ልጆችም መጥተው ሙሴንና ካህኑን አልዓዛርን፥ የማኅበሩንም አለቆች እንዲህ ብለው ተናገሩአቸው፦
“አጣሮት፥ ዲቦን፥ ያዜር፥ ነምራ፥ ሐሴቦን፥ ኤልያሌ፥ ሲባማ፥ ናባው፥ ቤያን፤
እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት የሰጣት ምድር የከብት መሰማሪያ ሀገር ናት፤ ለእኛም ለአገልጋዮችህ ብዙ እንስሳት አሉን።
እኛስ በአንተ ዘንድ ሞገስን አግኝተን እንደ ሆነ ይህን ምድር ለአገልጋዮችህ ርስት አድርገህ ስጠን፤ ዮርዳኖስን አታሻግረን።”
ሙሴም ለሮቤል ልጆችና ለጋድ ልጆች አላቸው፥ “ወንድሞቻችሁ ወደ ጦርነት ሲሄዱ እናንተ በዚህ ትቀመጣላችሁን?
እግዚአብሔር ወደሚሰጣቸው ምድር እንዳይሻገሩ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ልብ ለምን ታጣምማላችሁ?
ምድሪቱን ይሰልሉ ዘንድ ከቃዴስ በርኔ በላክኋቸው ጊዜ አባቶቻችሁ እንዲህ አድርገው አልነበረምን?
ወደ ወይን ዘለላ ሸለቆ መጡ፤ ምድሪቱንም አዩአት፤ እግዚአብሔርም ወደ ሰጣቸው ምድር እንዳይገቡ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ልብ መለሱ።
በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር ተቈጣ፤ እንዲህም ብሎ ማለ፦
ከግብፅ የወጡት ከሃያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉት መልካምንና ክፉን የሚያውቁ ሰዎች እኔን ፈጽመው አልተከተሉምና ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅ ለያዕቆብም እሰጥ ዘንድ የማልሁባትን ምድር አያዩም፤
እግዚአብሔርን ተከትለዋልና ከእነዚህ፥ ልዩ ከሆነ ከዮፎኒ ልጅ ከካሌብና ከነዌ ልጅ ከኢያሱ በቀር፤
እግዚአብሔርም በእስራኤል ላይ በጠና ተቈጣ። በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ ያደረገ ትውልድ ሁሉ እስኪጠፋ ድረስ አርባ ዓመት በምድረ በዳ ውስጥ አንከራተታቸው።
እነሆም፥ የእግዚአብሔርን መዓት በእስራኤል ላይ አብዝታችሁ ትጨምሩ ዘንድ እናንተ በኀጢአተኞች ሰዎች በደል በአባቶቻችሁ ፋንታ ተነሥታችኋል።
እርሱን ትታችሁታልና ዳግመኛም በምድረ በዳ ትታችሁታል፤ በዚችም ማኅበር ሁሉ ላይ ትበድላላችሁ።”
ወደ እርሱም ቀርበው አሉት፥ “በዚህ ለእንስሶቻችን በረቶችን፥ ለልጆቻችንም ከተሞችን እንሠራለን፤
እኛ ግን ለጦርነት ታጥቀን ወደ ስፍራቸው እስክናገባቸው ድረስ በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት እንሄዳለን፤ በዚህም ምድር ስላሉ ሰዎች ልጆቻችን በተመሸጉ ከተሞች ይቀመጣሉ።
የእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ርስታቸውን እስኪወርሱ ድረስ ወደ ቤታችን አንመለስም፤
ከዮርዳኖስ ወዲህ ወደ ምሥራቅ ርስታችን ደርሶናልና እኛ ከዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ወደዚያ ከእነርሱም ጋር ርስት አንወርስም።”
ሙሴም አላቸው፥ “ይህንስ እንዳላችሁት ብታደርጉ፥ ታጥቃችሁም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወደ ጦርነት ብትሄዱ፥
And he shall not cease from before his enemies until each man among you takes his weapon and crosses the Jordan before the Lord.
And the land shall be victorious before the Lord until you return; and before the Lord, you shall be pure in the sight of Israel; for this land shall be an inheritance before the Lord.
But if you do this, you shall be successful before the Lord; and when evil befalls you, you shall know your guilt.
For your children, cities; and for your cattle, pastures; do according to what comes forth from your mouth.”
And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad spoke to Moses, saying, “We are your servants, as our lord has commanded us, we shall do.”
Our children, our wives, and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead;
But we, your servants, shall all take our weapons and, as the Lord has spoken, we shall go to battle before you.
And Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the leaders of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel.

And Moses said, “If the children of Reuben and the children of Gad take their weapons and cross over with you before the Lord to battle, and if the land is victorious, you shall give them the land of Gilead as a possession.”

But if they do not take their weapons and do not cross over with you before the Lord to battle, then their children, their wives, and their livestock shall remain before you in the land of Canaan; and in the land of Canaan, they shall inherit their inheritance among you.”
And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad answered, saying, “Our Lord, as You have spoken to Your servants, so we will do.”
“Let us take our weapons and go before the Lord to the land of Canaan; for the inheritance that we shall receive from the Jordan is a goodly heritage,” they said.

And Moses gave to the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, and to the son of Joseph, to Manasseh, the land of the kingdom of Sihon, the king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og, the king of Bashan, and the cities of the land, and the cities that were round about them.
The children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer;
And Sophan, and Jazer;
And Nimrah, and they built seven cities and called them by their names; they also made folds for their flocks.
And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim; and they built the city of the fortress, and Shebam.
And these cities which they built, they called them by their names.
And the son of Manasseh, the son of Machir, went to Gilead and took it; and he destroyed the Amorites that were there.
And Moses gave Gilead to Machir, the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
And the son of Manasseh, Jair, went and took the towns thereof, and he called them by his own name, Havoth-jair.
And Nobah went and took Kenath and the villages thereof, and he called it Nobah, after his own name.

sections.title: A journey from Egypt unto Moab.

verses.text: This is the dwelling of the children of Israel after they departed from Egypt, along with the armies of Moses and Aaron.
And Moses wrote down the dwelling places of the children of Israel, as they journeyed according to the command of the Lord; this is the record of their journeys.
In the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month, they departed from Rameses; after the Passover, in the night, the children of Israel went out boldly before all the Egyptians.
At that time, the Egyptians were burying those whom the Lord had struck down among them; and the Lord had also executed judgment against their gods.
And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses and encamped at Succoth.
From Succoth they journeyed and encamped in the wilderness at Etham.
They journeyed from Etham and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, which is opposite Baal-zephon; they encamped before Migdol.
They journeyed from before Pi-hahiroth and went into the midst of the sea, and turned toward the wilderness; they journeyed three days in the wilderness of Etham and encamped at Marah.
From Marah they journeyed and came to Elim; at Elim there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees; and they encamped there by the waters.
They journeyed from Elim and encamped by the Red Sea.
And they journeyed from Eritrea and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
From the wilderness of Sin they journeyed and encamped in Dophkah.
And from Dophkah they journeyed and encamped in Elush.
And from Elush they journeyed and encamped in Rephidim; and there was no water for the people to drink.
And from Rephidim they journeyed and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
From the wilderness of Sin they journeyed and encamped at the grave of lust.
And from the grave of lust they journeyed and encamped in Abiroth.
And from Abiroth they journeyed and encamped in Rithmah.
And from Rithmah they journeyed and encamped in Remoth-Zophar.
And from Remoth-Zophar they journeyed and encamped in Libnah.
ከልብናም ተጕዘው በሪሳ ሰፈሩ።
ከሪሳም ተጕዘው በመቄላት ሰፈሩ።
ከመቄላትም ተጕዘው በሳፋር ሰፈሩ።
ከሳፋርም ተጕዘው በካሬደት ሰፈሩ።
ከካሬደትም ተጕዘው በመቄሎት ሰፈሩ።
ከመቄሎትም ተጕዘው በቀጠአት ሰፈሩ።
ከቀጠአትም ተጕዘው በተሪት ሰፈሩ።
ከተሪትም ተጕዘው በሚትቃ ሰፈሩ።
ከሚትቃም ተጕዘው በኤሴምና ሰፈሩ።
ከኤሴምናም ተጕዘው በመሱሩት ሰፈሩ።
ከመሱሩትም ተጕዘው በብንያቅን ሰፈሩ።
ከብንያቅንም ተጕዘው በገድገድ ተራራ ሰፈሩ።
ከገድገድም ተጕዘው በአጤቤት ሰፈሩ።
ከአጤቤትም ተጕዘው በኤብሮና ሰፈሩ።
ከኤብሮናም ተጕዘው በጋስዮንጋቤር ሰፈሩ።
ከጋስዮንጋቤርም ተጕዘው በጺን ምድረ በዳ ሰፈሩ። ከጺን ምድረ በዳም ተጕዘው በፋራን ምድረ በዳ ሰፈሩ። ይህችም ቃዴስ ናት።
ከቃዴስም ተጕዘው በኤዶምያስ ምድር ዳርቻ ባለው በሖር ተራራ ሰፈሩ።
ካህኑም አሮን በእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ወደ ሖር ተራራ ላይ ወጣ፤ በዚያም የእስራኤል ልጆች ከግብፅ ምድር ከወጡ በኋላ በአርባኛው ዓመት፥ በአምስተኛው ወር፥ ከወሩም በመጀመሪያው ቀን ሞተ።
አሮንም በሖር ተራራ ላይ በሞተ ጊዜ ዕድሜው መቶ ሃያ ሦስት ዓመት ነበረ።
በከነዓን ምድርም ተቀምጦ የነበረው ከነዓናዊው የዓራድ ንጉሥ የእስራኤል ልጆች እንደ መጡ ሰማ።
And they journeyed from Hor, and encamped in Selmona.
And from Selmona they journeyed, and encamped in Phemon.
And from Phemon they journeyed, and encamped in Aboth.
And from Aboth they journeyed, and encamped in the border of Moab, by the river.
And from the river they journeyed, and encamped in Dibon-gad.
And from Dibon-gad they journeyed, and encamped in Gelmon-diblahathaim.
And from Gelmon-diblahathaim they journeyed, and encamped before Naah, upon the mountains of Abarim.
And before Naah, from the mountains of Abarim they journeyed, and encamped by the Jordan, near Jericho, in the western part of Moab.
And by the Jordan, in the western part of Moab, they encamped from Asimoth even unto Abel-shittim.

sections.title: The commandments given unto the children of Israel before they crossed over the Jordan.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying, in the plains of Moab, by the Jordan near Jericho, thus:
"Speak unto the children of Israel, saying: Ye shall pass over the Jordan to the land of Canaan;
And ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you; and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places;
But ye shall dwell in the land, and I will give it unto you for a heritage; for I have said, I will give the land unto you.

Ye shall inherit the land, and ye shall divide it by lot among your families; to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance; every man's inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.

And when ye shall drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, those whom ye let remain shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides; and they shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
And I will do unto you as I thought to do unto them."

sections.title: The land of the hopeful and its inhabitants.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,
"Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel: Behold, ye shall enter into the land of Canaan; and the land of Canaan shall be an inheritance for you, as it is for the nations."
The border of the Azeb shall be from the wilderness of Zin along the edge of Edom; and the border of Azeb shall begin from the salt sea eastward.

And your border shall turn from the Aqrabim southward, toward Azeb; and it shall reach unto Enam; and the exit shall be at the border of Azeb, toward the east; and it shall reach unto the cities of the Aradites; and it shall not pass beyond Asmona.
And the border shall extend from Asmona unto Egypt, and the sea shall be your border.
"And for the sea, your border shall be the great sea; this shall be your border by the sea."
"On the side of the mountain, your border shall be toward the great sea."
From the mountain unto the mountain shall it be unto you; it shall reach unto Emath; and the exit of the border shall be at Seredek.
And the border shall not pass unto Diphron; and the exit shall be at Arsenai; and on the side of the mountain, your border shall be as this.
"On the eastern side, your border shall begin from the city of Sepham unto Arsenai."
ዳርቻውም ከሴፋማ በዐይን ምሥራቅ ወዳለው ወደ አርቤላ ይወርዳል፤ እስከ ኬኔሬት የባሕር ወሽመጥ በምሥራቅ በኩል ይደርሳል፤
ዳርቻውም ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ይወርዳል፤ መውጫውም በጨው ባሕር ይሆናል። ምድራችሁ እንደ ዳርቻዋ በዙሪያዋ ይህች ናት።”
ሙሴም የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዛቸው፥ “እግዚአብሔር ለዘጠኙ ነገድና ለምናሴ ነገድ እኩሌታ ይሰጡአቸው ዘንድ እንደ አዘዘ በዕጣ የምትወርሱአት ምድር ይህች ናት፤
የሮቤልም ልጆች ነገድ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤት፥ የጋድም ልጆች ነገድ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤት፥ የምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ርስታቸውን ወርሰዋል።
እነዚህ ሁለቱ ነገድና የአንዱ ነገድ እኩሌታ ርስታቸውን በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በኢያሪኮ አንጻር በምሥራቅ በኩል ወረሱ።”

sections.title: The leaders to whom the responsibility of dividing the land was given.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
“These are the names of the men who shall divide the land unto you as an inheritance; the priest Eleazar and Joshua the son of Nun.
And they shall take one chief from each tribe to divide the land for an inheritance among you.
And the names of the men are these: Caleb the son of Jephunneh, of the tribe of Judah;
And from the sons of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud;
And from the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon;
And from the sons of Dan, a chief, Bukki the son of Jogli;
And from the sons of Joseph, from the tribe of Manasseh, a chief, Hanniel the son of Ephod;
And from the sons of Ephraim, a chief, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan;
And from the sons of Zebulun, a chief, Elizaphan the son of Parnach;
From the children of Zebulun, there was a leader, a son of Helon, named Zelophehad.
From the children of Asher, there was a leader, a son of Shelomi, named Ahihud.
From the children of Naphtali, there was a leader, a son of Ammihud, named Pedahel.
The Lord commanded that these be appointed to distribute the inheritance of the land of Canaan to the children of Israel.

sections.title: Cities given to the Levites.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying, in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying:
"You shall give to the Levites cities to dwell in from the inheritance of the children of Israel, and you shall give to the Levites the suburbs of the cities round about them."
"And the cities shall be for them to dwell in; and their suburbs shall be for their cattle and for their beasts."
"And the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be from the wall of the city outward a thousand cubits round about."

"And you shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities."

"And you shall give to the Levites cities; and of the cities which you shall give them, six cities shall be cities of refuge, which you shall provide for the manslayer, and besides them you shall give forty-two cities."
"All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities; these shall be with their suburbs."

"And you shall give to the Levites cities from the inheritance of the children of Israel, according to the number of their inheritance, and from the many you shall take many, and from the few you shall take few; every one according to his inheritance which he inherits shall give of his cities unto the Levites."

sections.title: The cities of refuge.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው፦
“ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው፦
እነሆ፥ ወደ ከነዓን ምድር ዮርዳኖስን ትሻገራላችሁ፤ ባላማወቅ ነፍስ የገደለ ወደዚያ ይሸሽ ዘንድ የመማፀኛ ከተሞች እንዲሆኑላችሁ ከተሞችን ለእናንተ ለዩ።
ነፍሰ ገዳዩ በማኅበሩ ፊት ለፍርድ እስከሚቆም ድረስ እንዳይሞት፥ ከተሞቹ ከደም ተበቃይ የመማፀኛ ከተሞች ይሁኑላችሁ።
የምትሰጡአቸውም ስድስቱ ከተሞች የመማፀኛ ከተሞች ይሁኑላችሁ።
በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ሦስት ከተሞችን ትለያላችሁ፤ በከነዓንም ምድር ሦስት ከተሞችን ትለያላችሁ፤ የመማፀኛ ከተሞችም ይሆናሉ።
ባለማወቅ ነፍስ የገደለ ሁሉ ይሸሽባቸው ዘንድ እነዚህ ስድስት ከተሞች ለእስራኤል ልጆች፥ በመካከላቸውም ለሚቀመጡ እንግዶችና መጻተኞች መማፀኛ ይሆናሉ።
“በብረት መሣሪያ ቢመታው፥ ቢሞትም ነፍሰ ገዳይ ነው፤ ነፍሰ ገዳዩም ፈጽሞ ይገደል።
ሰውም በሚሞትበት በእጁ ባለው ድንጋይ ቢመታው፥ የተመታውም ቢሞት፥ እርሱ ነፍሰ ገዳይ ነው፤ ነፍሰ ገዳዩም ፈጽሞ ይገደል።
ሰውም በሚሞትበት በእጁ ባለው በእንጨት መሣሪያ ቢመታው፥ የተመታውም ቢሞት፥ እርሱ ነፍሰ ገዳይ ነው፤ ነፍሰ ገዳዩም ፈጽሞ ይገደል።
The blood of the slain shall be avenged by his own soul; in the time of its discovery, it shall be avenged.
If a thorn should pierce him, or if any matter should cause him to be pricked, even if he dies,

Or if, by a piercing, he should be struck down until death by hand, the one who struck shall surely be avenged; for he is a soul-slayer; and if he has blood, or if he is slain in the time of its discovery, his soul shall be avenged.
"But if a stone should fall upon him without malice, and without any matter causing him to be pricked,
Or if, without seeing, he should strike a stone that causes a man to die until death,
Even if he has no enemy, nor does evil befall him, the community shall judge between the slayer and the one who has blood, in this manner:

The community shall deliver the soul-slayer from the hand of the one who has blood; and the community shall return to the city of refuge where he fled; and there he shall dwell until the great priest dies, who was anointed with the holy oil.
But if the soul-slayer should go out from the border of the city of refuge, and the one who has blood should find him outside the border of the city of refuge,
And the one who has blood should slay the soul-slayer, there shall be no guilt upon him;

For it was fitting that he should dwell within the city of refuge until the death of the great priest. But after the death of the great priest, the soul-slayer shall return to the land of his inheritance.
"These things shall be for your children, for your offspring, as statutes and judgments in all your dwelling places."
"Every soul that hath sinned shall die by the mouth of witnesses; but by the mouth of one witness, no man shall be put to death."
"Do not accept a ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death; he shall surely be put to death."
"You shall not accept a ransom from the great priest until he returns to the ground; do not accept a price from him for his escape."

"For the land is defiled by blood, and you shall not pollute the land wherein you dwell by bloodshed; for the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, except by the blood of him that shed it."
"You shall not pollute the land wherein you dwell, for I am the Lord who dwells among you; I am the Lord your God."

sections.title: A heritage appointed for the daughters of the land.

verses.text: And the clans of the children of Joseph, the son of Manasseh, the son of Machir, the son of Gilead, came forward; and they spoke before Moses and before Eleazar the priest, and before the leaders of the fathers of the children of Israel, saying,

"The land was commanded to be given as an inheritance to the children of Israel, to be distributed by lot, as the Lord our God commanded; and the Lord commanded that the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad be given to his daughters."

If they should marry from another tribe of the children of Israel, their inheritance would be taken from the inheritance of our fathers; and they would add to the inheritance of the tribe to which they belong; thus would our inheritance be diminished.

And when the jubilee of the children of Israel shall come, their inheritance shall be added to the tribe to which they belong; behold, their inheritance shall be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers.
And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the Lord, saying, "The daughters of Joseph speak rightly."
This is what the Lord commanded concerning the daughters of Zelophehad: 'Let them marry whom they think best; only they shall marry within the family of their father's tribe.'
Thus shall the inheritance of the children of Israel not pass from tribe to tribe; for every one of the children of Israel shall keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

And every one of the children of Israel shall inherit the inheritance of his fathers; and every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall marry within the family of her father's tribe.
Thus shall no inheritance pass from one tribe to another; for every one of the children of Israel shall keep the inheritance of his tribe.
And the Lord commanded Moses, even so did the daughters of Zelophehad.
የሰለጰዓድ ሴቶች ልጆች መሐላ፥ ቴርሳ፥ ሄግላ፥ ሚልካ፥ ኑኃ ከአባታቸው ወንድሞች ልጆች ጋር ተጋቡ።
ከዮሴፍ ልጅ ከምናሴ ልጆች ወገኖች ባሎቻቸውን አገቡ፥ ርስታቸውም በአባታቸው ነገድ ጸና።
እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ የእስራኤልን ልጆች በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ በኢያሪኮ አንጻር በሞዓብ ምዕራብ ያዘዛቸው ትእዛዝ፥ ሥርዐትና ፍርድ እነዚህ ናቸው።
